arxiv:2610.11887.authors: Daniele Bartoli, Giovanni Giuseppe Grimaldi, Giovanni Longobardi

arxiv:2610.11905.title: Uniform Height Gaps in Arbitrary Characteristics
arxiv:2610.11905.summary: We prove uniform height gaps for subvarieties of abelian varieties in arbitrary characteristic, extending the new gap principle of Gao-Ge-K\"{u}hne. Our proof goes through the theory of adelic curves and globally valued fields, and proves the Bogomolov conjecture for an arbitrary globally valued field. This gives a different way to obtain uniform Bogomolov-type results, differing from the approaches of Dimitrov-Gao-Habegger-K\"{u}hne and Yuan.
arxiv:2610.11905.authors: Alice Lin, Frank Lu, Jit Wu Yap

arxiv:2610.11913.title: Formally Certifying the Vertex Set of a Polyhedron Faster than Informal Enumeration
arxiv:2610.11913.summary: The computation of the vertices of a polyhedron described by a system of linear inequalities is a central problem in polyhedral computation. It is a fundamental step in the conversion between H-representations, by linear inequalities, and V-representations, by vertices and extreme rays. This operation plays an important role both in the study of polyhedra and their combinatorics in mathematics and in applications to software and system verification.
arxiv:2610.11913.authors: Xavier Allamigeon, Yazid Id-Sahra, Pierre-Yves Strub

arxiv:2610.11916.title: Bounds on the maximum number of limit cycles of piecewise linear Lienard systems II. The discontinuous case
arxiv:2610.11916.summary: This paper concerns the planar Li\'enard system \(\dot x=y-F(x),\ \dot y=-x\), where \(F(x)\) is a piecewise linear function with exactly \(m\) jump points and no fold points. Tonnelier [SIAM J. Appl.
arxiv:2610.11916.authors: Hebai Chen, Jie Jin, Shu Li, Yuhuan Lu

arxiv:2610.11925.title: On Calabi-Yau varieties that are linear sections of Grassmannians of lines
arxiv:2610.11925.summary: In this paper we consider the $n-3$ dimensional linear section $X_\Pi$ of the Grassmannian $\mathbb G(1,n)$ of lines in $\mathbb P^n$ with a general linear space $\Pi$ of codimension $n+1$, with $n=2k+1$ odd and $n\geq 5$, that is a Calabi-Yau variety. Related to $X_\Pi$ there is a degree $k+1$ Pfaffian hypersurface $\mathcal C_\Pi$ that is the intersection of the dual of $\mathbb G(1,n)$ with $\Pi^\perp$. We prove that $\mathcal C_\Pi$ is rational and we provide a birational parametrization of it.
arxiv:2610.11925.authors: Michele Bolognesi, Ciro Ciliberto, Alessandro Verra

arxiv:2610.11926.title: Covering radius of rank-metric codes via covering lifts and clubs
arxiv:2610.11926.summary: We introduce a generator-matrix-based geometric approach to the covering radius of $\mathbb F_{q^m}$-linear rank-metric codes. Starting from the $q$-system associated with the code, we define the notion of covering lift and show that the covering radius can be recovered from the hyperplane weights of such lifts. This yields an exact criterion, in terms of the length and effective length of the code, for the covering radius to attain its largest possible value, together with the upper bound $\rho(\mathcal{C})\le \min\{m,n\}-1$ in all remaining cases.
arxiv:2610.11926.authors: Giuseppe Marino, Alessandro Neri, Alessia Vallefuoco

arxiv:2610.11941.title: On the Number of Hamiltonian Cycles in a Boolean Cube
arxiv:2610.11941.summary: It is shown that, as $n\to\infty$, the logarithm of the number of decompositions into cycles of the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube $E^n$ is \[ 2^n(\ln n-1+o(1)), \] and the logarithm of the number of Hamiltonian cycles in $E^n$ is at least \[ 2^{n-1}(\ln n-1+o(1)). \] It is proved that, in $E^n$, every perfect matching whose edges belong to at most $k$ directions can be extended to a Hamiltonian cycle for every $n\geq n_0(k)$.
arxiv:2610.11941.authors: A. L. Perezhogin, V. N. Potapov

arxiv:2610.11965.title: Pythagorean pairs in boxes of prime powers
arxiv:2610.11965.summary: Let $p_i$ be the $i$th prime, and let $f(N)$ be the largest cardinality of a subset of \[ \left\{\prod_{i=1}^N p_i^{a_i}:0\le a_i<N,\ a_i\in\mathbb{Z}\right\} \] containing no two distinct legs of an integer right triangle. We prove \[ f(N) \ll N^N (\log\log N)^{-1/1296}. \]

arxiv:2610.11979.title: Tensor triangular geometry of band algebras
arxiv:2610.11979.summary: In this paper, we study the tensor triangular geometry of band algebras $RB$, where $B$ is a finite left regular band and $R$ is a commutative Noetherian ring. We show that the Balmer spectrum of $\Perf(RB)$ is homeomorphic to $\Spec R\times L_B$, where $L_B$ is the support lattice of $B$. We also show that there is a bijection between the localizing ideals of $D(RB)$ and the stable subsets of $\Spec R\times L_B$.

arxiv:2610.11997.title: Fractional majority coloring of digraphs: bounds and inapproximability
arxiv:2610.11997.summary: A set of vertices in a digraph is majority-stable if each of its vertices has at most half of its outneighbors in the set. A fractional majority coloring assigns nonnegative weights to such sets, covering each vertex to total weight at least one; its minimum total weight is the fractional majority coloring number. We prove that every finite loopless digraph has fractional majority coloring number at most \(523/140<3.736\), improving the bound \(3.9602\) of Anastos, Lamaison, Steiner and Szab\'o.

arxiv:2610.12013.title: Unipotent Selmer dimensions for CM curves via Iwasawa loci
arxiv:2610.12013.summary: Let $X/\mathbb{Q}$ be a smooth, projective, geometrically integral curve of genus $g \geq 2$ with a point $ b \in X(\mathbb{Q})$ and geometrically CM Jacobian. Fix an odd prime $p$ of good reduction, and let $U$ be the \'etale pro-unipotent $\mathbb{Q}_p$-fundamental group of $X$. We prove, for all $n \gg 0,$ the inequality $\dim_{\mathbb{Q}_p} H^1_f(G_T, U_n) < \dim_{\mathbb{Q}_p}H^1_f(G_p, U_n)$ of Bloch--Kato Selmer schemes, with their ratio having limit superior at most $1/2$.

arxiv:2610.12032.title: Further bounds in the polynomial Szemer\'edi theorem
arxiv:2610.12032.summary: We show that there exists $c > 0$ such that any subset of $\{1,\ldots,N\}$ having size $\gg N / \exp( (\log\log\log N)^c )$ contains a nontrivial pattern of the form $x,x+y,x+2y,x+y^3$. It is the first configuration of complexity strictly greater than $0$, other than refinements of arithmetic progressions, for which quantitative bounds over integers were obtained.
arxiv:2610.12032.authors: Bart{\l}omiej Bychawski, Bartosz G{\l}owacki, Ivan Spyrydonov

arxiv:2610.12036.title: Constructing pathological symmetric abstract rigidity matroids
arxiv:2610.12036.summary: We prove that for each $d \geq 2$, there exist infinitely many symmetric abstract $d$-rigidity matroids that are not the $d$-rigidity matroid, the $d$-hyperconnectivity matroid, or the $d$-cofactor matroid. When $d=2$, our constructed matroids are pathological, in the sense that they are not contained within any abstract 2-rigidity matroid family. Our construction additionally provides a counter-example to a conjecture of Tyomkyn.

arxiv:2610.12037.title: Hyperplane winning for bad in manifolds
arxiv:2610.12037.summary: We prove the hyperplane winning property of weighted badly approximable vectors inside nondegenerate analytic manifolds and affine subspaces satisfying almost optimal Diophantine conditions. This, in particular, answers a conjecture of Badziahin--Velani for higher-dimensional manifolds, including affine cases that were understood only in $\mathbb{R}^2$.

arxiv:2610.12054.title: Self measurable embeddings of mapping class groups
arxiv:2610.12054.summary: Given a finite-type orientable surface without boundary, outside of a few low-complexity surfaces, we show that any measurable embedding of the associated mapping class group into itself is a measure equivalence. This is a measure-theoretic analog to the result of Ivanov and McCarthy that mapping class groups are co-Hopfian.

arxiv:2610.12071.title: Rational curves on toroidal compactifications of Picard modular varieties
arxiv:2610.12071.summary: It was known that the canonical bundle of a smooth toroidal compactification of a noncompact finite-volume ball quotient is nef in dimension $n\geq3$ and ample in dimension $n\geq6$. We prove that the canonical bundle is ample in dimension $n\geq4$ and show that this dimension bound is sharp. We construct infinitely many pairwise noncommensurable noncompact Picard modular threefolds whose smooth projective toroidal compactifications have non-ample canonical bundle.

arxiv:2610.12072.title: Strict Hausdorff-dimension drop for Quartic Salem Bernoulli convolutions
arxiv:2610.12072.summary: For every quartic Salem number $\beta$, we prove that the equal-weight Bernoulli convolution $\nu_{\beta^{-1}}$ has Hausdorff dimension strictly less than one. The main step converts large Fourier coefficients at geometrically separated frequencies into a deficit in the Shannon entropy of a finite convolution. A positive trigonometric product gives the entropy estimate, while the algebraic norm controls the number of distinct atoms in each spatial cell.
arxiv:2610.12072.authors: Guozheng Cheng, Xiang Fang, Xueqing Ma, Hongli Zhang

arxiv:2610.12078.title: Linear syzygies and linear subspaces whose lines are multisecant
arxiv:2610.12078.summary: The locus $S_d(X)$ of $d$-secant lines to a projective variety $X$ plays an important role in the study of projective varieties via projections (Lazarsfeld 1987, Kwak 1998, Beheshti-Eisenbud 2010). For a projective scheme $X\subseteq\mathbb{P}^r$ satisfying $\textbf{N}_{d,2}$, we show that $S_d(X)\cup X$ is cut out set-theoretically by the $r$-minors of a matrix $M$ constructed from $d$-forms scheme-theoretically defining $X$ and their linear syzygies. In particular, $S_d(X)=\mathbb{P}^r$ if and only if every $r$-minor of $M$ vanishes.

arxiv:2610.12079.title: Fiber product of condensable algebras and critical points of boundary phase transitions
arxiv:2610.12079.summary: In this work, we propose a mathematical description of the critical point of boundary phase transitions in 2+1D topological orders. Given two boundary phases, $\mathcal{C}_A$ and $\mathcal{C}_B$, with corresponding Lagrangian algebras $A$ and $B$ in a 2+1D topological order $\mathcal{C}$, respectively, we propose that the critical point of the phase transition between these two phases, if it exists, corresponds to $D = A \times_{M} B$, which is the fiber product of $A$ and $B$ over $A$-$B$-algebra $M$. We prove that $D$ is also a condensable algebra.

arxiv:2610.12080.title: A uniform bound for the minimal degree of an isogeny between principally polarized superspecial abelian surfaces
arxiv:2610.12080.summary: Let $p>3$ be a prime number. If $A$ and $B$ are two principally polarized superspecial abelian surfaces over $\mathbb{F}_{p^{2}}$ with $p^{2}$-Frobenius $[-p]$, we prove that there exists a separable polarized isogeny between them with multiplier at most $p/\sqrt{2}$. The multiplier bound is uniform in the pair and asymptotically optimal up to a small multiplicative constant.

arxiv:2610.12091.title: On the kernels of Lefschetz operators
arxiv:2610.12091.summary: We study the kernels of Lefschetz operators arising from complete intersections of nef classes. When the classes are semiample, we provide a complete characterization of mixed Lefschetz properties below a fixed degree -- all obstructions are detected by irreducible subvarieties of relevant codimensions. We further show that the kernels in the next degree range vanish off the diagonal, while on the diagonal they admit bases consisting of fundamental classes of irreducible subvarieties annihilated by the Lefschetz operator.

arxiv:2610.12092.title: Character variety of the five-punctured sphere and the determinantal quintic hypersurface
arxiv:2610.12092.summary: Using skein-theoretic methods, we study the SL2(C) character variety of the five-punctured sphere with arbitrary conjugacy class at each of the five punctures. We show that a Fricke-Klein-Vogt-type relation is realized as a symmetric determinantal hypersurface. We also give a realization of the character variety in terms of cluster variables.

arxiv:2610.12109.title: Sharp linear Tur\'an remainders for cycle and edge extremality
arxiv:2610.12109.summary: For a graph $G$, let $e(G)$ denote the number of edges of $G$, and let $c(G)$ be the number of distinct cycles in $G$. Morrison, Roberts and Scott asked whether, for every fixed graph $H$ and all large $n$, some $n$-vertex $H$-free graph maximizes both $e(G)$ and $c(G)$. In this paper, we show that the answer is no for every possible chromatic number.
arxiv:2610.12109.authors: Jifu Lin, Xiaolin Wang, Guangmiao Yu

arxiv:2610.12110.title: Adaptive dynamic programming using Lyapunov function constraints
arxiv:2610.12110.summary: This work is concerned with a stabilizing adaptive dynamic programming (ADP) approach to approximate solution of a given infinite-horizon optimal control problem. Since the latter problem cannot, in general, be solved exactly, a parametrized function approximator for the infinite-horizon cost function is introduced in ADP (so called ``critic''). This critic is used to adapt the parameters of the function approximator.
arxiv:2610.12110.authors: Thomas G\"ohrt, Pavel Osinenko, Stefan Streif

arxiv:2610.12122.title: Lower bounds for Ramsey numbers: $\mathrm{R}(6,8)\ge 135$ and $\mathrm{R}(8,10)\ge 345$
arxiv:2610.12122.summary: We prove the lower bounds $\mathrm{R}(6,8)\ge 135$ and $\mathrm{R}(8,10)\ge 345$, improving the bounds 134 and 343 listed in the April 2026 revision of Radziszowski's dynamic survey. We give explicit red/blue colorings of $K_{134}$ with no red $K_6$ or blue $K_8$, and of $K_{344}$ with no red $K_8$ or blue $K_{10}$, and verify them with two independently written exhaustive clique checkers. Starting from published colorings, we find these witnesses by adding vertices and repairing the resulting monochromatic cliques through local search.

arxiv:2610.12175.title: Atiyah classes and ellipticity of Oka manifolds
arxiv:2610.12175.summary: We prove that every weakly pseudoconvex Oka manifold admitting a positive line bundle is elliptic in the sense of Gromov, thereby proving Gromov's ellipticity conjecture. The proof establishes a cohomological construction of local sprays. Given a bundle morphism $\varphi\colon E\to T_X$, we introduce quadratic $\varphi$-vector fields on $E$ whose flows yield local sprays with fibre derivative $\varphi$.

arxiv:2610.12180.title: Mutually unbiased bases: common states, completion, and extension obstructions
arxiv:2610.12180.summary: Which pure states give uniform outcomes in several mutually unbiased measurements, and when can they form another measurement basis? We distinguish common unbiased states, their orthonormal completion, and further extension. For a displayed phase-deformed Fourier pair in dimension $2m$, a clock symmetry and skew antiunitary complete every prescribed common unbiased state to an explicit orthonormal basis.

arxiv:2610.12192.title: Topological inequalities for conic-line arrangements with some prescribed singularities
arxiv:2610.12192.summary: We study arrangements of conics and lines in the complex projective plane from the viewpoint of 4-manifolds. We introduce combinatorial conic-line arrangements, the conic-line counterpart of rank-3 matroids, together with their topological and smooth realisations, and we ask which restrictions on a complex arrangement survive when its components are replaced by locally-flat spheres in the same homology classes with the same local singularity models. For an ADE combinatorial conic-line arrangement of even total degree admitting a topological realisation we prove a Hirzebruch-type inequality; the proof uses only branched covers and the local topology of rational double points.

arxiv:2610.12197.title: Limit Theorems for Persistent Homology of Multiparameter Complex Processes
arxiv:2610.12197.summary: Multiparameter complex processes, based on the Costa-Farber model, provide a common framework for growing random simplicial complexes, including the Linial-Meshulam and random flag complex processes. We establish laws of large numbers for persistent Betti numbers of these processes and prove that, after a deterministic time change and normalization, their persistence diagrams converge weakly in probability to a deterministic finite measure. Its quadrant masses are determined by universal limits of normalized persistent Betti numbers, characterized by an explicit finite-dimensional optimization problem.

arxiv:2610.12218.title: Hierarchical Melnikov Realization: Logarithmic Factor Improvement to Hilbert Number Lower Bounds
arxiv:2610.12218.summary: The second part of Hilbert's 16th problem is one of the most fundamental open problems in the qualitative theory of ordinary differential equations and dynamical systems. A central unresolved question is whether the Hilbert number $H(d)$ is finite for arbitrary polynomial degree $d$. (A very recent manuscript from OpenAI asserts the finiteness of $H(d)$; see the remark at the end of this paper.) In the absence of a general upper bound theory, most existing work constructs explicit perturbed polynomial systems to obtain improved lower bounds for $H(d)$, while rigorous upper bound estimates remain largely unavailable.

arxiv:2610.12222.title: On Igusa's conjectures for weighted homogeneous polynomials with isolated singularities
arxiv:2610.12222.summary: In 1991, Denef introduced an explicit formula for Igusa's local zeta functions in terms of embedded resolutions of singularities over $p$-adic fields with good reduction. In this paper, by slightly generalizing the $p$-adic McKay correspondence given by the second author in 2017, we extend Denef's result to the setting of $\mathbb{Q}$-embedded resolutions of singularities. Consequently, the strong monodromy conjecture with respect to Igusa's local zeta functions holds for weighted homogeneous polynomials with isolated singularities.

arxiv:2610.12237.title: A unified approach to infinite log-concavity of combinatorial sequences
arxiv:2610.12237.summary: We establish a sufficient condition for infinite log-concavity and apply it to five families of combinatorial sequences. We give a new proof of infinite log-concavity for the Boros--Moll coefficient sequences $(d_k(n))_{k=0}^n$ for fixed $n$. For the transposed sequences $(d_\ell(\ell+k))_{k\ge0}$, we prove Zhao's conjecture on infinite log-concavity for every fixed integer $\ell\ge3$.
arxiv:2610.12237.authors: Matthew H. Y. Xie, Candice X. T. Zhang, Philip B. Zhang

arxiv:2610.12246.title: Postcritically finite endomorphisms II: Fatou sets
arxiv:2610.12246.summary: Let $f$ be a postcritically finite endomorphism of the complex projective space $\mathbb{P}^N$ of degree at least two. We prove that every Fatou component of $f$ is preperiodic to the basin of a superattracting periodic orbit.

arxiv:2610.12254.title: Higher-rank local mixing for cusped positive representations
arxiv:2610.12254.summary: Let $\Gamma<\operatorname{PSL}_2(\mathbb R)$ be a torsion-free, non-elementary, finitely generated Fuchsian group with parabolic elements, and let $\rho:\Gamma\to G$ be a type-preserving, Zariski dense, positive representation into a connected split semisimple real algebraic group. We prove quantitative local mixing for Bowen--Margulis--Sullivan measures on $\rho(\Gamma)\backslash G/M$, where $M$ is the centralizer of a maximal split torus in a compatible maximal compact subgroup. For every $u$ in the interior of the limit cone of $\rho(\Gamma)$, correlations of smooth compactly supported functions along $\exp(tu)$, normalized by $t^{(\operatorname{rank}_{\mathbb R}G-1)/2}$, admit a…
arxiv:2610.12254.authors: Dongryul M. Kim, Hee Oh, Wenyu Pan

arxiv:2610.12255.title: Wedges, Rational completion and $\mathbb Q$-bad spaces
arxiv:2610.12255.summary: Let $A$ and $X$ be connected based CW complexes with $H_1(A;\mathbb Q)\neq 0$, and let $m\geq 1$ be the least degree with $\widetilde H_m(X;\mathbb Q)\neq0$. We prove that the Bousfield--Kan rational completion map of $A\vee X$ induces a map on $H_{2m}(-;\mathbb Q)$ whose cokernel has dimension at least $2^{\aleph_0}$. In particular, $A\vee X$ is $\mathbb Q$-bad.

arxiv:2610.12258.title: Intersections of quantitative recurrence and badly approximable sets for expanding Markov maps
arxiv:2610.12258.summary: We study a class of expanding Markov maps on the unit interval, which includes sofic \(\beta\)-transformations, Gauss maps, tent maps and cookie-cutter maps. We investigate the quantitative recurrence property for points that are dynamically badly approximable, namely, points whose orbits eventually remain a positive distance from a given point. We show that the Hausdorff dimension of the intersection of a recurrence set and a badly approximable set is determined by the same pressure function as that of the corresponding recurrence set.

arxiv:2610.12261.title: Hyperquiver varieties
arxiv:2610.12261.summary: We discuss the recently introduced concept of hyperquivers, due to Muller, Nanda, and Seigal, from the point of view of K\"ahler and hyperk\"ahler quotients. In particular, we show that the K\"ahler hyperquiver variety ${\mathcal M}$, corresponding to a hyperquiver with a single hyperedge, is a projective variety isomorphic to the geometric quotient of the space of tensors with maximal multilinear rank. Moreover, the hyperk\"ahler hyperquiver variety corresponding to doubling of this hyperquiver can be identified with the linear scheme corresponding to the sheaf of reflexive $1$-forms on ${\mathcal M}$.

arxiv:2610.12263.title: The graph complex and the homology of the general linear groups revisited
arxiv:2610.12263.summary: We revisit the relation between the Kontsevich commutative graph complex and the homology of $\GL(n,\Z)$ found by Brown--Chan--Galatius--Payne using the sharbly complex of Ash--Miller--Patzt.

arxiv:2610.12268.title: Furstenberg discretization with moment control and entropy rigidity
arxiv:2610.12268.summary: Let $G$ be a locally compact group, let $\Gamma$ be a lattice in $G$, and let $\eta$ be a spread-out probability measure on $G$. A Furstenberg discretization of $\eta$ to $\Gamma$ is a probability measure $\mu$ on $\Gamma$ such that every $(G,\eta)$-stationary space is also $(\Gamma,\mu)$-stationary. For cocompact lattices $\Gamma$ and under mild regularity conditions on $\eta$, we construct Furstenberg discretizations satisfying finite moment conditions of arbitrary order with respect to arbitrary prescribed subadditive functions.
arxiv:2610.12268.authors: Benjamin Anderson-Sackaney, Tim de Laat, Ebrahim Samei, Matthew Wiersma

arxiv:2610.12277.title: Hyperk\"ahler SYZ conjecture
arxiv:2610.12277.summary: We prove the hyperk\"ahler SYZ conjecture: the sections of some power of a non-trivial nef isotropic line bundle define a Lagrangian fibration.

arxiv:2610.12279.title: Invariant sets and spectral rigidity of Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms
arxiv:2610.12279.summary: We solve a well-known question of Polterovich from 2002 regarding the rigidity of Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms in Hofer's metric in dimension two: every non-trivial Hamiltonian diffeomorphism of a surface of genus at least one has all positive iterations separated from the identity in Hofer's metric. In higher dimensions, we make progress on the case of autonomous Hamiltonian flows: we prove Hofer non-recurrence for symplectically hyperbolic manifolds, and completely characterize Hofer recurrence for functions of the moment polytope on monotone toric manifolds. These results apply equally well to Viterbo's spectral metric, settling cases of the $\gamma$-rigidity conjecture, and therefore in…

arxiv:2610.12280.title: Generalized linear cellular automata in groups and difference Galois theory II
arxiv:2610.12280.summary: In the first part of this series the $\sigma$-ring spanned by the periodic solutions of a generalized linear cellular automaton in a discrete group was shown to be Hopf--Galois, with pro-algebraic Galois group, while a Galois theory for the $\sigma$-ring spanned by the finite support solutions was left open, with parameterized difference Galois theory suggested as the tool. We apply that tool to automata over $\mathbb Z$. The Fourier transform turns the automaton into a rank one equation $\sigma(\hat x)=\hat\alpha\hat x$ over a field on which $\delta=z\,d/dz$ acts, and we compute, and algorithmically decide, its parameterized Galois group: for genuine automata with symbols rational in the…
arxiv:2610.12280.authors: David Bl\'azquez-Sanz, Mario Alejandro Vergara Tapiero

arxiv:2610.12288.title: Testing Algebraic Complete Intersections
arxiv:2610.12288.summary: Given independent and identically distributed samples samples from a probability distribution in a potentially high-dimensional real space, we study the problem of testing whether the distribution is concentrated near a real algebraic complete intersection of prescribed dimension, bounded degree, and bounded condition number. We design an explicit and effective learning procedure which either certifies the nonexistence of such a manifold, up to a controlled relaxation of the approximation threshold, or returns a candidate regression manifold with controlled geometric complexity. Equivalently, the procedure tests the manifold hypothesis within this hypothesis class.

arxiv:2610.12301.title: Measurable obstructions for unmeasurable colourings
arxiv:2610.12301.summary: Due to the availability of powerful analytic techniques, vastly superior lower bounds are known for the measurable chromatic number of Euclidean spaces compared to their ordinary chromatic number. Indeed, even the breakthrough lower bound of 5 for the famous Hadwiger-Nelson problem lagged over 35 years behind that of the measurable setting. This raises the fundamental question of whether the measurable and ordinary chromatic number of Euclidean spaces differ as conjectured by Sz\'ekely in 1984.

arxiv:2610.12302.title: Drilling veering triangulations with applications to pseudo-Anosov flows
arxiv:2610.12302.summary: We develop an algorithm that takes as input a veering triangulation V and a flow cycle c of V, and outputs a veering parent V_c of V. Constructing veering parents combinatorializes drilling out closed orbits of transitive pseudo-Anosov flows. The algorithm relies on locally approximating the structure of the loom space associated to V in sufficient detail to carry out a certain modification of the Agol-Gu\'eritaud construction.

arxiv:2610.12319.title: A minimal model for rate-induced tipping to extinction
arxiv:2610.12319.summary: Rate-induced tipping ("R-tipping") in ecological modelling is characterised by too-rapid change of an environmental parameter causing collapse of a population without any bifurcation being crossed ("B-tipping"). A well-known example of a slow-fast predator-prey model in which R-tipping is observed [Vanselow, Wieczorek, Feudel, Journal of Theoretical Biology, 479, 64-72 (2019)] suffers from unecological "resurgence", whereby populations driven to functional extinction recover towards stable coexistence. We propose an analytically tractable model, incorporating a strong Allee effect into the prey dynamics in a slow-fast Lotka-Volterra-type predator-prey system, which induces bistability and…
arxiv:2610.12319.authors: Brian Hennessy, Nikola Popovi\'c, Zak Sattar

arxiv:2610.12326.title: On the Nazarov-Sklyanin Lax operator for Macdonald functions
arxiv:2610.12326.summary: We study the Lax operator for Macdonald symmetric functions introduced by Nazarov and Sklyanin in 2015, extending the spectral theory developed by Mickler-Moll in the Jack case. We extend the NS operator to a Lax operator acting on symmetric functions with coefficients in polynomials in an auxiliary variable, and prove it has an orthogonal eigenbasis indexed by partitions and their addable corners, with the corner contents as eigenvalues, and leading terms given by Macdonald symmetric functions. We obtain the Macdonald analogue of the author's earlier Jack box-sum identity for Littlewood-Richardson coefficients.

arxiv:2610.12330.title: Characteristic cycles and the Gevrey filtration of irregularity in hypergeometric families
arxiv:2610.12330.summary: We show that the characteristic cycle multiplicities of $A$-hypergeometric systems are upper semicontinuous in the parameter for every rational projective weight, thereby proving a conjecture of Schulze and Walther [Duke Math. J. 142 (2008), 465--509]. The proof uses a specialization formula for filtered families satisfying a fixed product support condition, expressing the difference between the special and generic characteristic cycles as the characteristic cycle of the first Tor module.

arxiv:2610.12331.title: Wave packets asymptotics in $\kappa$-minkowski space
arxiv:2610.12331.summary: In this paper, we study the nature of wave packets and their decay behavior in the $\kappa$-Minkowski space. We employ techniques from singularity theory throughout our analysis. Specifically, we use methods from the theory of Lagrangian singularities and caustics to study the topology of the energy-level manifold.

arxiv:2610.12344.title: Geometrically Abelian Sections on Higher-Dimensional Varieties
arxiv:2610.12344.summary: We investigate how much arithmetic information about a variety can be detected by sections of the geometrically abelian fundamental groups of sufficiently small open subvarieties. Over a \(p\)-adic field, such a section determines a rational point on the Albanese torsor, and, under a conjectural assumption, this point is represented by a \(0\)-cycle of degree \(1\) on the original variety if the variety has index \(1\). For curves, the latter statement holds unconditionally.

arxiv:2610.12347.title: Coloring graphs of homologous spheres
arxiv:2610.12347.summary: The curve graph of a surface is the graph whose vertices are isotopy classes of essential, closed curves on the surface. Edges join vertices with disjoint representatives. The curve graph plays a central role in the theory of mapping class groups of surfaces.
arxiv:2610.12347.authors: Edgar A. Bering IV, Samantha Ford, Aarav Ghai, Maxwell Lyon, Om Shah

arxiv:2610.12351.title: Prevalence of sparsity for negatively curved metrics
arxiv:2610.12351.summary: Let $M$ be a closed manifold of arbitrary dimension. The length spectrum of a negatively curved metric $g$ on $M$ is the set of lengths of all possible closed geodesics of $g$. We prove that metrics whose length spectrum is exponentially sparse, i.e., the gaps between distinct lengths are bounded below by a quantity decaying exponentially in the length, are prevalent, and hence dense, among $C^k$-smooth negatively curved metrics on $M$ for sufficiently large $k$.

arxiv:2610.12352.title: The Colored Jones Function does not determine any colored Links--Gould polynomial
arxiv:2610.12352.summary: We prove that there is no uniform description of $\mathrm{LG}^{(n)}$ in terms of colored Jones polynomials for all knots, even when allowing infinitely many colors and arbitrary operations. We prove the $n=1$ case, using an existing cabling formula and the separation of the Conway and Kinoshita--Terasaka knots by $\mathrm{LG}^{(2)}$. We develop an odd cabling formula and use a Vandermonde argument to show that for each $n\geq 2$ some satellite of each of these knots is distinguished by $\mathrm{LG}^{(n)}$.

arxiv:2610.12358.title: Subspace Uncertainty and Sharp Sampling Thresholds on the Boolean Cube
arxiv:2610.12358.summary: We study Gaussian regression under squared population $L_2$ loss in a known $m$-dimensional subspace of degree-at-most-$k$ functions on the $d$-dimensional Boolean cube. Random inputs can undersample regions essential for prediction, delaying the parametric rate even when the model is known. For fixed $q_0<1/2$, $1\le k\le q_0d$, and sufficiently large fixed $A$, the worst-subspace sample threshold for minimax error $A\sigma^2(m+t)/n$ with confidence $1-e^{-t}$, $t\ge\log4$, is \[ N=(m+t)\exp\{E_{d,k}+O(k^{1/3})\}, \quad E_{d,k}=d\Psi(k/d), \] where $\Psi(q)=\log2-\mathsf H(\tfrac12-\sqrt{q(1-q)})$ and $\mathsf H$ is binary entropy with natural logarithms.

arxiv:2610.12364.title: The moduli space of curves of genus 16 is uniruled
arxiv:2610.12364.summary: Using in a novel way non-abelian Brill-Noether theory, we show that the moduli space of curves of genus 16 is uniruled. This is the highest genus for which such a result is known.

arxiv:2610.12370.title: Bilevel optimization for data-driven learning of Koopman embeddings using kernel-based autoencoders
arxiv:2610.12370.summary: Koopman operator theory provides a linear framework for analyzing nonlinear dynamical systems and has become a major tool for data-driven modeling. A central challenge, however, is that finite-dimensional approximations computed by methods such as extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD) require the dictionary to be specified a priori. Recent machine-learning approaches address this limitation by learning the dictionary from data, predominantly using artificial neural network (ANN) autoencoder architectures.
arxiv:2610.12370.authors: Joel-Pascal Ntwali N'konzi, Feliks N\"{u}ske, Stefan Klus

arxiv:2610.12384.title: Local Constancy of the Betti Automorphic Category over the Moduli of Curves
arxiv:2610.12384.summary: Nadler and Yun conjectured that the automorphic side of the Betti geomet- ric Langlands correspondence forms a local system of categories over the moduli of curves. We prove this local constancy conjecture using purely microlocal methods, independent of the recently estab- lished Betti geometric Langlands conjecture. In particular, it follows that the Betti automorphic category depends only on the genus of the curve, verifying a conjecture of Ben-Zvi and Nadler.

arxiv:2610.12392.title: Tiling 3D by Translates of a Single Polycube is Undecidable
arxiv:2610.12392.summary: We prove co-RE-completeness, and thus undecidability, of the following problem: given a single (connected) polycube, decide whether it tiles 3D Euclidean space by translations. We reduce from Wang tiling using the decorated two-prime Sudoku construction of Greenfeld and Tao and a cyclic encoding adapted from OpenAI's 3D aperiodic tile, and apply a reduction of Kim to make the prototile connected (via faces). Dimension three is optimal: translational monotiling is known to be decidable in $\mathbb{Z}^2$ and for a single (possibly disconnected) polyomino in $\mathbb{R}^2$.

arxiv:2610.12433.title: The Hilton-Milner theorem in the $\ell_2$-norm
arxiv:2610.12433.summary: The Hilton-Milner theorem is a classical theorem in extremal set theory which determines the maximum size of a nontrivial $k$-uniform intersecting family. In this paper, we prove an exact version of the Hilton-Milner theorem in the $\ell_2$-norm. Our method also gives an asymptotic version of the Hilton-Milner theorem in the $(j, p)$-norm.

arxiv:2610.12434.title: Global asymptotic stability of homogeneous polynomial vector fields is undecidable
arxiv:2610.12434.summary: We study the decision problem of global asymptotic stability (GAS) of the origin for homogeneous polynomial vector fields with rational coefficients. In the first part of the paper we give, for every fixed dimension $n$ and odd degree $2k+1$, a computable map which sends a homogeneous vector field of degree $2k+1$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$ to a homogeneous cubic vector field on $\mathbb{R}^m$, $m=\binom{n+k-1}{k}$, and preserves both GAS and Lyapunov stability. The map passes to new variables $y_\alpha=x^\alpha$ (one for each monomial $x^\alpha$ of degree $k$), in which the vector field becomes cubic, and adds a cubic penalty term transverse to the set of points of the form…
arxiv:2610.12434.authors: Ivan O. Shevchenko, Jun Liu, Xinzhi Liu

arxiv:2610.12446.title: Self-intersecting sections of polar actions on simply connected manifolds
arxiv:2610.12446.summary: We construct a polar action of $\mathrm{SU}(3)$ on a closed simply connected $11$-manifold with a compact three-dimensional section that is not injectively immersed. The section is injective over the regular part and has two distinct local branches along a singular stratum. All isotropy groups are connected, and all orbits are simply connected.

arxiv:2610.12484.title: Products of Boolean Clones up to Minion Homomorphisms
arxiv:2610.12484.summary: We study the minion homomorphism poset of multisorted Boolean clones. Our main result completely determines the subposet induced by products of Boolean clones: every inequality between prod- ucts is induced by inequalities between their Boolean factors. Furthermore, we determine the minion cores of all products of Boolean clones, thereby identifying canonical representatives of their minion homomorphic equivalence classes.

arxiv:2610.12490.title: Homogeneous symmetric trace-positive sextics with vanishing abelianization are sums of Hermitian squares and commutators
arxiv:2610.12490.summary: Let $\mathbb{R}\langle X,Y\rangle$ be the free algebra on two symmetric letters. A polynomial is trace-positive if it has non-negative trace on every pair of real symmetric matrices, and it lies in the cone $\Theta$ if it is cyclically equivalent to a sum of Hermitian squares. Burgdorf and Klep proved that the two notions coincide in degree at most four; from degree six onwards they differ.

arxiv:2610.12497.title: Singular Levi-flats and holomorphic foliations on projective spaces
arxiv:2610.12497.summary: We study codimension-one holomorphic foliations admitting invariant singular real-analytic Levi-flat varieties. Our main problem is to determine when the local meromorphic first integrals furnished by the Levi-flat geometry can be continued coherently and globalized. We introduce a pencil-singularity condition and a projective compatibility condition for local meromorphic parameters.

arxiv:2610.12508.title: The Game Chromatic Number of Complete Multipartite Graphs with Singletons and Large Parts
arxiv:2610.12508.summary: We study the game chromatic number of complete multipartite graphs whose parts are either singletons or are of size at least four. Building on the work of Pawe\l Obszarski et al., we give a formula in terms of the ordered part sizes, and the number of singleton parts.

arxiv:2610.12513.title: Maximal Order Type and Width of the h-Preorder on Finite Labeled Trees
arxiv:2610.12513.summary: We establish tight bounds for the width and maximal order type of the h-preorder on Q-labeled trees in terms of the corresponding invariants of well-quasi-order Q.

arxiv:2610.12531.title: Lusztig Parameters and Factorizations of Determinantial Modules
arxiv:2610.12531.summary: We give an explicit formula for the Lusztig parameters of determinantial modules over symmetric quiver Hecke algebras. The formula applies to every Bruhat pair and every fixed reduced expression of the upper Weyl group element. In finite types $A$, $D$, and $E$, we identify the parameters of the modules in M\'enard's seed using Demazure weaves.

arxiv:2610.12576.title: Minor exclusion and planar rigidity
arxiv:2610.12576.summary: We prove that every connected, locally finite, quasi-transitive graph which is quasi-isometric to a graph excluding a countable clique as a minor is quasi-isometric to a planar graph. Consequently, every finitely generated group with such a quasi-isometry is virtually planar, meaning that some finite-index subgroup admits a planar Cayley graph. We also show that a connected, locally finite, quasi-transitive graph admitting a regular map into a bounded-degree graph excluding some finite minor admits a regular map into a bounded-degree planar graph.

arxiv:2610.12613.title: Maximal Linear Arrangement is NP complete on Bipartite Graphs
arxiv:2610.12613.summary: The linear arrangement of a simple graph $G = (V,E)$ is a bijective labeling $\pi$ of the vertices of $G$ to the set $\{1, \ldots, n\}$. The maximum linear arrangement ($\texttt{maxLA}$) problem is to determine whether $G$ has a labeling such that the sum of labels across $G$'s edges, $\sum_{uv \in E} |\pi(u) - \pi(v)|$, is at least a given value $k$. Minimum linear arrangement ($\texttt{minLA}$) is defined analogously.

arxiv:2610.12630.title: Equality Cases in the Tu-Deng Conjecture Bound
arxiv:2610.12630.summary: The Tu-Deng Conjecture, made in 2011, asserts that for $k\geq2$ and $1\leq t<2^k-1$, the set \[ S_{t,k}=\left\{(a,b)\in\{0,1,\ldots,2^k-2\}^2: a+b\equiv t\pmod{2^k-1},\quad \wt(a)+\wt(b)<k\right\} \] satisfies \[ |S_{t,k}|\leq 2^{k-1}. \] Proofs of the conjecture were given independently by the author and by Liu, Luo and Xie in arXiv in 2026. Let $r=\wt(t)$, and let $z=k-r$ be the number of zeros in the $k$-bit expansion of $t$.

arxiv:2610.12633.title: The first homology of square-section braid groups
arxiv:2610.12633.summary: We compute the first homology of the unordered configuration space of $n$ open unit-squares in the $w$ by $h$ rectangle for all positive integers $n$, $w$, and $h$. Letting $w$ and $h$ vary, these square configuration spaces form a bi-filtration of the unordered configuration space of $n$ points in the plane, so their fundamental groups approximate the $n$-strand braid group. Using a pair of spectral sequences, we prove that these square and point configuration spaces have naturally isomorphic first homology groups if $w,h\ge 3$ and $n\le wh-3$.
arxiv:2610.12633.authors: Minh Pham, Nicholas Wawrykow, Jacob Zweiback

arxiv:2610.12640.title: Frugal coloring in planar graphs with maximum degree 4 and 5
arxiv:2610.12640.summary: A proper coloring of vertices of a graph $G$ is called $t$-frugal if no color appears more than $t$ times in the neighborhood of any vertex of $G$. While $1$-frugal coloring coincides with $2$-distance coloring, we study $2$-frugal colorings of planar graphs with maximum degree $4$ and $5$, respectively. We prove that every planar graph with maximum degree $4$ admits a $2$-frugal coloring with $7$ colors, while a planar graph with maximum degree $5$ admits a $2$-frugal coloring with $10$ colors.
arxiv:2610.12640.authors: Bo\v{s}tjan Bre\v{s}ar, P\v{r}emysl Holub, Marko Jakovac, Petra Melicharov\'a

arxiv:2610.12675.title: Hook algebras and determinantal varieties
arxiv:2610.12675.summary: In characteristic zero, we prove that the Tor algebras of the generic, symmetric, and skew-symmetric determinantal rings are Koszul with respect to a natural regrading. In particular, their Eilenberg--Moore spectral sequence degenerates, which allows us to explicitly determine the Poincar\'e series of their residue fields and answers a problem raised by Avramov. To do this, we construct the universal hook algebra and prove that it has a quadratic Gr\"obner basis and thus is Koszul.
arxiv:2610.12675.authors: Steven V Sam, Keller VandeBogert, Jerzy Weyman

arxiv:2610.12678.title: Limit theorems for random matrix products with a simple top Lyapunov exponent
arxiv:2610.12678.summary: We study products of independent, identically distributed random matrices with an exponential moment and a simple top Lyapunov exponent, without assuming irreducibility. Outside an exceptional invariant subspace called the equator, we establish contraction on average for a weighted projective distance and a spectral gap for the associated Markov operator. We obtain a central limit theorem, a Berry--Esseen bound, deviation estimates near the mean, and an almost sure invariance principle both for the growth of a fixed vector outside the equator and for the operator norm.

arxiv:2610.12683.title: Nef Hattori classes and products of projective lines
arxiv:2610.12683.summary: Let \(X\) be a smooth connected complex projective variety with an effective algebraic \(\mathbb C^{\times}\)-action, a nonempty finite fixed locus whose weights are \(\pm1\). We show that if its Hattori line bundles are nef, then \(X\) is algebraically isomorphic to \((\mathbb{P}^1)^{\dim X}\), and these bundles become the hyperplane bundles of the factors. The product statement follows from the nef-complexity classification of Enwright and collaborators, and we describe the isomorphism through global sections.

arxiv:2610.12690.title: Reconstruction of Finite Posets of Width Three
arxiv:2610.12690.summary: We prove that every finite ordered set of width at most three and cardinality at least four is reconstructible from its deck. This settles the width-three part of an open problem posed by Schr\"oder in Ordered Sets; the separate question concerning ordered sets of height one is not addressed here. The new ingredient is a criterion for recovering the marked maximal deck of an ordered set with exactly three maximal elements from its unmarked maximal deck and the isomorphism type of the suborder obtained by deleting all maximal elements.

arxiv:2610.12697.title: Toward Maximizing Algebraic Connectivity via Density-Dependent Backbone Construction and Reinforcement Learning Completion
arxiv:2610.12697.summary: This paper studies an open network design problem of constructing graph topologies with maximum algebraic connectivity under fixed numbers of vertices and edges. A density-dependent approach is proposed that decomposes the design task into two stages: a high-quality, low-cost structural backbone construction and a reinforcement learning completion stage. The method selects the backbone based on density, using complete multipartite graphs in dense regimes and Cayley graphs in low-to-intermediate regimes, and then refines the remaining edges through a learning-based procedure.
arxiv:2610.12697.authors: Zeru Zhu, Marco Gamarra, Ji Liu

arxiv:2610.12698.title: Pointwise H\"older continuity of Lyapunov exponents of random matrix products
arxiv:2610.12698.summary: We prove that if the first Lyapunov exponent of a compactly supported random matrix product is simple, then it is pointwise H\"older continuous for the Wasserstein--Hausdorff distance. By passing to exterior powers, we obtain pointwise H\"older continuity of the first $k$ exponents whenever they are simple.

arxiv:2610.12720.title: The Stable Marriage Polytope is Box-Totally Dual Integral
arxiv:2610.12720.summary: A stable matching in a bipartite preference system is a matching that has no unmatched pair whose endpoints both prefer each other to their current assignments. Rothblum gave a linear description of the stable marriage polytope, the convex hull of the incidence vectors of stable matchings. We prove that this polytope is box-totally dual integral.

arxiv:2610.12736.title: $G$-Equivariant Hilbert Schemes and Quadratic Forms
arxiv:2610.12736.summary: For a finite abelian group $G$ acting linearly on the plane let $\mathcal{X}$ be the associated quotient stack. We analyze a fine moduli space which parameterizes zero dimensional substacks of $\mathcal{X}$ whose corresponding subschemes of the plane have a given representation type, denoted by $\mathcal{X}^{[\rho]}$. By means of a Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch theorem of To\"en we give explicit representation theoretic formulas of $\dim(\mathcal{X}^{[\rho]})$ for all $\rho \in \operatorname{Rep}(G)$ which are similar to the McKay correspondence.

arxiv:2610.12748.title: Algebraic Vector Bundles on Cluster Varieties
arxiv:2610.12748.summary: We study algebraic vector bundles on cluster varieties. Over a perfect field of characteristic different from two, every algebraic vector bundle is trivial on a cluster variety with principal coefficients at an acyclic seed of irreducible finite Dynkin type. The proof is based on integral contractions of cellular $\mathbb A^1$-chain complexes and successive freezing.

arxiv:2610.12767.title: Efficient lifts into odd dimensions of Spherical $5$- and $7$-designs with Balanced Halves
arxiv:2610.12767.summary: We propose constructions of spherical $5$- and $7$-designs in odd dimensions by lifting balanced halves of even-dimensional designs to several layers of suitable latitudes. For every odd dimension, we obtain an explicit spherical $5$-design with at most $60(d^2-1)$ points, attaining the optimal quadratic order in the dimension. Assuming Zauner's conjecture, this bound improves to $7.5(d-1)^2$.

arxiv:2610.12785.title: Chern classes of Levi non-degenerate CR manifolds
arxiv:2610.12785.summary: We construct closed Levi non-degenerate CR manifolds with non-vanishing Chern monomials. For every $n \geq 2$ and $\lceil n / 4 \rceil \leq m \leq \lfloor n / 2 \rfloor$, there exists a $(2 n + 1)$-dimensional example of signature $(\lfloor n / 2 \rfloor, \lceil n / 2 \rceil)$ on which all Chern monomials with positive indices at most $m$ and total weight at most $n - m$ are non-zero in cohomology with real coefficients. Taking $m = \lceil n / 4 \rceil$ gives examples with $c_{1}^{\lfloor 3 n / 4 \rfloor} \neq 0$.

arxiv:2610.12808.title: Quasipositive Braids, Presentations, and Garside Structures
arxiv:2610.12808.summary: We provide a presentation of the braid group in which the generating set is the set of all positive half-twists, the relations are balanced positive relations, and every relation is conjugate to one in a finite list. We then prove that for any such presentation, its positive monoid is not isomorphic to the quasipositive braid monoid. Finally, we show that the quasipositive braid monoid has no proper Garside family.

arxiv:2610.12819.title: A Simple Explicit Construction of Smaller Strong Blocking Sets
arxiv:2610.12819.summary: Alon, Bishnoi, Das and Neri constructed sequences of strong blocking sets in $(k-1)$-dimension projective space $P({\bf F}_q, k-1)$ with sizes at most $Cqk$, where $k$ goes to the infinity and $C$ is a fixed positive constant not depending on $q$, in their paper published in Transactions AMS, vol. 277, pp. 5389-5410, 2024. This is equivalent to a sequence of minimal $[n_i,k_i]_q$ codes with positive rate $\frac{k_i}{n_i} \geq c$, where $k_i$ goes to the infinity and $c$ is a fixed positive constant only depending on $q$. They solved one of the main open problems on minimal codes.

arxiv:2610.12831.title: Reasonable bounds for Restricted Polynomial Progressions in $\mathbb F^n_p$
arxiv:2610.12831.summary: Given an integer $k \geq 2$ and a prime $p$ large enough depending on $k$, we show that, if $A \subseteq \mathbb F^n_p$ does not contain a restricted polynomial progression of the form \begin{align*} x, x+\begin{pmatrix} y_1 \\ y_2 \\ \vdots \\ y_n \end{pmatrix}, x+\begin{pmatrix} y_1^2 \\ y_2^2 \\ \vdots \\ y_n^2 \end{pmatrix}, \ldots, x+\begin{pmatrix} y_1^{k-1} \\ y_2^{k-1} \\ \vdots \\ y_n^{k-1} \end{pmatrix}, \end{align*} where $x \in \mathbb F^n_p$ and $y \in \{0,2, 3, \ldots, M_k\}^n \backslash \{\vec{0} \}$, for some fixed $M_k$, then $A$ must have density bounded above by $\frac{C}{(\log^{(k^{O(k)})} n)^c}$, where $C, c>0$ only depend on $k$ and $p$. For $k\geq 4$, the best…
arxiv:2610.12831.authors: Alex Burgin, Anastasios Fragkos, David Kruzel, Michael Lacey, Amelia Stokolosa

arxiv:2610.12836.title: Connectivity, toughness, and hamiltonicity of simplicial polytopes
arxiv:2610.12836.summary: For every $d\ge4$, every prescribed connectivity $r\ge d$, and every $\varepsilon>0$, we construct a simplicial $d$-polytope whose graph has connectivity exactly $r$, is nontraceable, and has toughness less than $\varepsilon$. Thus the classical theorems of Whitney (1931) and Tutte (1956), which guarantee hamiltonicity under sufficiently high connectivity in dimension three, have no higher-dimensional counterpart. This answers a question posed by Bojan Mohar in 2001 on whether sufficiently high connectivity guarantees hamiltonicity of $4$-polytopal graphs and the connectivity questions raised by Ikegami, Maezawa, and Zamfirescu in 2021.

arxiv:2610.12839.title: Derived plethystic algebra
arxiv:2610.12839.summary: We prove comparison results about $\infty$-categories of derived commutative rings with extra algebraic structure. For example, we show that several notions of derived $\delta$-rings agree and obtain similar results for derived $\lambda$-rings, derived binomial rings, and derived Boolean rings. Our comparison results apply more generally to modules over a specific kind of monad on derived rings that we call derived plethory.
arxiv:2610.12839.authors: Benjamin Antieau, Edith H\"ubner, Dmitry Kubrak, Joost Nuiten

arxiv:2610.12854.title: Normal bundles of hyperelliptic curves and uniform propagation of semistability
arxiv:2610.12854.summary: Let $C$ be a smooth hyperelliptic curve of genus $g\ge2$ over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. We prove that the normal bundle of the embedding of $C$ in $\mathbb{P}^n$, $n\ge3$, by the complete linear series of a general line bundle of degree $n+g$ is semistable if and only if $n\ge3g+1$. By openness, general complete embeddings of general curves of genus $g$ also have semistable normal bundle when $n\ge3g+1$.

arxiv:2610.12869.title: Odd order cases of Chowla's averages over arbitrary rectangles
arxiv:2610.12869.summary: Let $\lambda$ be the Liouville function. In this paper we prove an average form of Chowla Conjecture for even $k $. that is, for every fixed even integer $k\geq 2$, we prove that \[ \lim_{\min\{M,N\}\to \infty}\frac{1}{MN}\sum_{m=1}^M\sum_{n=1}^N\lambda(m)\lambda(m+a_1n)\cdots\lambda(m+a_kn)=0. \] We construct a stationary model for both averaging variables, derive the finite conditional-entropy estimates.
arxiv:2610.12869.authors: Qiang Huo, Zhengxing Lian, Kangbo Ouyang

arxiv:2610.12905.title: Codegree-Constrained Tur\'an Problems for $F_5$ and Its Blow-ups
arxiv:2610.12905.summary: Let $F_5$ denote the $3$-uniform hypergraph with edge set $\{abc,abd,cde\}$. For a hypergraph property $\mathcal P$, let $ex_{\mathcal P}(n,F_5)$ be the maximum number of edges in an $n$-vertex $F_5$-free $3$-uniform hypergraph satisfying $\mathcal P$. Let $\Delta_2(H)$ denote the maximum codegree of a pair of vertices in a $3$-uniform hypergraph $H$.

arxiv:2610.12918.title: A Comparison Theorem for $p$-adic GKZ Hypergeometric $\mathcal D$-Modules and Complexes
arxiv:2610.12918.summary: We compare the $p$-adic GKZ hypergeometric complex with the hypergeometric arithmetic $\mathcal D$-module defined via six functors. Under the $p$-adic semi-nonresonance condition, the natural comparison morphism is a quasi-isomorphism. We prove concentration of the $p$-adic GKZ hypergeometric complex in degree $n$, establish overholonomicity under another non-Liouville hypothesis.

arxiv:2610.12945.title: On the composition of permutons
arxiv:2610.12945.summary: Permutons can be thought of as "continuum limits" of permutations of diverging size, which encode information about the number of occurrences of any given finite subpattern. We construct a natural composition operation on permutons, analogous to composition of permutations, and explore its properties via a correspondence between permutons, Markov kernels, and Markov operators. We show that no extension of permutation composition to permutons can be (jointly) continuous with respect to the usual "weak" topology on permutons, but we construct a "strong" topology with respect to which composition is jointly continuous.

arxiv:2610.12949.title: Quantum-assisted rendezvous on hypercubes: a quantum Bernoulli noise approach
arxiv:2610.12949.summary: We study quantum-assisted balanced rendezvous on the $d$-dimensional hypercube in a one-step two-agent quantum-walk framework, where the two agents move the same Hamming distance and meet at a common midpoint. The key structure is a projective $t$-sphere resolution, which governs exact finite-dimensional quantum attainment. Its scalar analogue recovers the corresponding classical characterization.

arxiv:2610.12950.title: Markovian Random Words, a Gaussian Random Matrix Model and Beyond
arxiv:2610.12950.summary: After centering and scaling, the length of the longest weakly increasing subsequence of a finite-state Markov random word converges to a Brownian last-passage functional with dependent components. We investigate when this functional, and more generally the limiting RSK Young-diagram shape, admits a Gaussian random-matrix representation. We introduce Hermitian Gaussian matrices with correlated diagonal entries and show that isotropy of the Brownian covariance on the trace-zero hyperplane yields such a representation.

arxiv:2610.12955.title: The biwheel conjecture for braces
arxiv:2610.12955.summary: Let $b(n)$ denote the minimum number of perfect matchings in a simple brace of order $n$. De~Carvalho, Lucchesi and Murty (SIAM Journal on Discrete Mathematics, 27(2): (2013) 940-958) proved that $b(n)\ge(n-2)^2/8$ and conjectured that $b(n)=(n-2)^2/4$ for all sufficiently large even $n$. We prove this conjecture.

arxiv:2610.13042.title: Covering plane curves over finite fields with lines
arxiv:2610.13042.summary: We prove that, for every fixed $d\geq 2$ and $\varepsilon>0$, the $\mathbb{F}_q$-points of a geometrically irreducible reflexive plane curve of degree $d$ over $\mathbb{F}_q$ can be covered by at most $\left(\frac{1}{d}+\varepsilon\right)q$ many $\mathbb{F}_q$-lines, provided that $q$ is sufficiently large. The same conclusion holds for $\mathbb{F}_q$-irreducible curves that are not geometrically irreducible, since they have only $O(d^2)$ $\mathbb{F}_q$-points. In particular, for sufficiently large $q$, the bound applies to every $\mathbb{F}_q$-irreducible plane curve of degree $d$ when $\operatorname{char}(\mathbb{F}_q)>d$.
arxiv:2610.13042.authors: Shamil Asgarli, Sarthak Dassarma, Dragos Ghioca, Simon MacLean, Evan Stokdyk

arxiv:2610.13063.title: The Order Mass Identity of Rooted Forests, with a Direct Proof of the Extended Aldous--Broder Theorem
arxiv:2610.13063.summary: Random spanning forests provide probability models for partitions and Monte Carlo methods on graphs. In these applications, the distribution produced by a sampler determines which forest functionals can be estimated. The Aldous--Broder algorithm constructs a spanning tree from the first-entrance edges of a covering random walk.

arxiv:2610.13068.title: Uniform Exponential Attractors for Non-Autonomous Dynamical Systems and an Application to the damped hyperbolic equation with sub-quintic growth
arxiv:2610.13068.summary: In this paper, we develop an abstract framework for the theory of uniform exponential attractors in non-autonomous dynamical systems. Our construction employs time-dependent absorbing sets while ensuring exponential attraction among the constructed sets. Moreover, we show that the resulting exponential attractors are uniform-that is, they remain stable under perturbations.

arxiv:2610.13085.title: Resolving Pisanski's Conjecture
arxiv:2610.13085.summary: We prove Pisanski's conjecture on quadrilateral embeddings of regular bipartite graphs. For integers $m\geq d\geq4$ with $4\mid md$, we construct both a connected simple $d$-regular bipartite graph $G$ with $m$ vertices in each bipartition class and an orientable quadrangulation. This graph's genus is \[ \ga(G)=1+\frac{m(d-4)}4.

arxiv:2610.13091.title: A Lipschitz refinement of the Bebutov-Kakutani dynamical embedding theorem for connected Lie group actions
arxiv:2610.13091.summary: Let $G$ be a connected Lie group equipped with a compatible right-invariant metric and let $G$ act continuously on a compact metrizable space $X$. We prove that $X$ admits a $G$-equivariant embedding into the right argument shift action on the space of one-Lipschitz maps from $G$ to $[0,1]$ if and only if the set of fixed points topologically embeds into $[0,1]$. This generalizes a theorem proved by Gutman, Huo and Tsukamoto for $\mathbb{R}^k$-flows.
arxiv:2610.13091.authors: Yonatan Gutman, Qiang Huo, Kangbo Ouyang

arxiv:2610.13099.title: Khintchine dichotomy for images of self-similar measures and almost random walks
arxiv:2610.13099.summary: Following the celebrated breakthrough in B\'enard-He-Zhang, we prove Khintchine dichotomy for push-forwards of self-similar measures on $\mathbb{R}^d$ under uniform $C^{1+\alpha}$ maps. For this, we also study almost random walks on $\mathrm{SL}(d+1,\mathbb{R})/\mathrm{SL}(d+1,\mathbb{Z})$ and prove their effective equidistribution.

arxiv:2610.13100.title: Finiteness of planar central configurations of five bodies for all positive masses
arxiv:2610.13100.summary: We prove that for every choice of five positive masses the planar five-body problem has finitely many central configurations up to similarity. This settles Smale's sixth problem for five bodies in the plane. Albouy and Kaloshin proved it for masses outside a closed algebraic subset of codimension two.

arxiv:2610.13103.title: Additive bases and the zero-sum invariant $\mathsf{N}(G)$ for groups $C_p\oplus C_{np}$
arxiv:2610.13103.summary: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group, and let $c_0(G)$ be the least integer such that every regular sequence over $G$ of at least this length is an additive basis. Let $\mathsf N(G)$ be the least integer $l$ such that every weak-regular sequence $S$ over $G$ with $|S|\ge l$ has a nonempty zero-sum subsequence $T$ satisfying $\mathsf v_g(T)=\mathsf v_g(S)$ for some $g\mid S$. We obtain a common upper bound for $c_0(C_q\oplus C_{nq})$ for groups of odd order, where $q$ is prime, and prove $\mathsf N(G)\ge r(n_r-1)+1$ when $G=C_{n_1}\oplus\cdots\oplus C_{n_r}$ with $1<n_1\mid\cdots\mid n_r$.

arxiv:2610.13114.title: Degree Adjacency Diametrical Matrix of Graphs Spectral Properties and Energy Bounds
arxiv:2610.13114.summary: Graph matrices that combine structural and metric information have attracted considerable attention in spectral graph theory. In this paper, we introduce the \emph{Degree--Adjacency--Diametrical (DAD) matrix} of a connected graph $G$. The DAD matrix is defined by \[ (DAD(G))_{ij}= \begin{cases} d(v_i), & \text{if } i=j, 1, & \text{if } v_i\sim v_j, \operatorname{diam}(G), & \text{if } d(v_i,v_j)=\operatorname{diam}(G), 0, & \text{otherwise}, \end{cases} \] where $d(v_i)$ denotes the degree of the vertex $v_i$.

arxiv:2610.13160.title: Hausdorff Dimension and Flexibility for Attractors of Non-Uniformly Hyperbolic Flows
arxiv:2610.13160.summary: We study the Hausdorff dimension of attracting sets of three-dimensional flows whose one-dimensional quotient dynamics is non-uniformly expanding. Our main assumption is that the quotient map admits a full-branch uniformly expanding Gibbs--Markov induced map. We first prove that every such attractor contains a hyperbolic horseshoe of Hausdorff dimension strictly larger than two.

arxiv:2610.13178.title: Boundedness of polarized log Calabi-Yau fibrations
arxiv:2610.13178.summary: We investigate the boundedness problem for log Calabi-Yau fibrations whose bases and general fibers are bounded. We improve the results in arXiv:2504.05243 from birational boundedness to actual boundedness, which confirms a conjecture of Birkar and Hacon when the boundary coefficients belong to a fixed finite rational set. We also get a new proof for the birational boundedness result in arXiv:2504.05243 which is substantially more conceptual.

arxiv:2610.13192.title: Classification of can-Var diagrams of mixed Hodge structures and monodromic mixed Hodge modules on $\mathbb{C}$
arxiv:2610.13192.summary: By our previous work, the category of unipotent monodromic mixed Hodge modules on $\mathbb{C}$ is equivalent to the category of can-Var diagrams of mixed Hodge structures. In this paper, we show that the associated graded diagram with respect to the weight filtrations decomposes as a finite direct sum of four basic types tensored with pure Hodge structures, which we call a split graded model. We then show that every unipotent monodromic mixed Hodge module is represented by a split graded model together with a finite family of $\mathbb{C}$-linear maps.

arxiv:2610.13204.title: On the Quantitative Bounds of Nonlinear Roth Theorem
arxiv:2610.13204.summary: We prove that any subset $A \subseteq \{1, \dots, N\}$ lacking non-trivial polynomial progressions $(x, x + y, x + y^2)$ satisfies $\lvert A \rvert \le CN \exp\bigl(-c(\log \log N)^\beta\bigr)$ for effective absolute constants $C, c, \beta > 0$. The argument develops a density increment framework localized to anisotropic quadratic Bohr sets. To handle mixed linear and quadratic frequencies, we establish a multilinear transference principle coupled with a relative quadratic inverse theorem based on Balog--Szemer{\'e}di--Gowers additive energy rigidity.

arxiv:2610.13209.title: Open WDVV equations for non-commutative families of bounding cochains
arxiv:2610.13209.summary: We derive the noncommutative open WDVV equations for the open Gromov-Witten superpotential introduced in joint work of the author and Solomon, extending the Solomon-Tukachinsky equations to noncommutative differential graded algebras. The resulting recursive formulas facilitate the computation of open Gromov-Witten invariants with multiple boundary point constraints for even-dimensional Lagrangians. We apply the open WDVV equations to compute all open Gromov-Witten invariants for the real loci of even-dimensional complex quadrics of dimension greater than two.

arxiv:2610.13210.title: Symmetries of colored Khovanov-Rozansky homology
arxiv:2610.13210.summary: We construct an action of the positive half of the Witt algebra on colored $\mathfrak{gl}_N$-Khovanov-Rozansky homology and prove that this action is compatible with the functoriality of colored link homology. To establish this result, we use Bar-Natan's framework of canopolies to formulate and prove the relevant statements at the level of tangles.

arxiv:2610.13213.title: Haar measure for totally positive split real semisimple quantum groups of classical type
arxiv:2610.13213.summary: Let $\hbar$ be a non-zero real number and put $q= e^{-\pi i \hbar}$. Let $G$ be a semisimple split real Lie group of classical type, with Lie algebra $\mathfrak{g}$ and associated Borel subalgebra $\mathfrak{b} \subseteq \mathfrak{g}$. We show that there exists a locally compact quantum group $(L_{\hbar}(B),\Delta)$ which integrates the Borel part $U_q(\mathfrak{b})$ of the Drinfeld--Jimbo quantized enveloping algebra $U_q(\mathfrak{g})$, viewed as a Hopf $*$-algebra.
arxiv:2610.13213.authors: Kenny De Commer, Geoffrey Janssens, Wannes Malfait

arxiv:2610.13254.title: Dimension theory of group actions by circle diffeomorphisms I: Stationary measures
arxiv:2610.13254.summary: We establish a structure theorem for smooth random walks on the circle and study the dimensional properties of their stationary measures, including exact dimensionality and a Ledrappier-Young-type dimension formula. These results provide the technical tools needed for the main theorems in Part II "Dimension theory of group actions by circle diffeomorphisms II: Minimal sets". They also yield an approximation theorem in the spirit of Katok, Avila-Crovisier-Wilkinson, and Morris-Shmerkin, together with a time-reversal symmetry for circle actions: every semigroup $T$ contained in $\mathrm{Diff}_+^{1+\alpha}(\mathbb{S}^1)$ without finite orbits has the same number of minimal sets as its inverse…
arxiv:2610.13254.authors: Weikun He, Yuxiang Jiao, Disheng Xu

arxiv:2610.13260.title: Recognizing oriented knots from finite quotients with one marked element
arxiv:2610.13260.summary: For an oriented tame knot $K$, let $G_K$ be its group, with positive meridian $\mu_K$ and preferred longitude $\lambda_K$. We prove that the profinite completion $\widehat{G_K}$, marked by the conjugacy class of $\mu_K\lambda_K$, determines $K$ up to oriented equivalence. In fact, every isomorphism preserving this mark preserves the meridian and longitude with the same conjugator.

arxiv:2610.13270.title: Polynomial directed treewidth forces a large bramble with congestion two
arxiv:2610.13270.summary: Brambles of constant congestion in directed graphs have interesting structural and algorithmic applications, and it is desirable to find the smallest function $f_c(k)$ such that if a digraph has directed treewidth at least $f_c(k)$, then it contains a bramble of size at least $k$ and congestion at most $c$. By the Directed Grid Theorem of Kawarabayashi and Kreutzer [STOC 2015], such a function $f_c(k)$ exists for every value $c \geq 2$ of the congestion. However, even using the recent improvements due to Hatzel et al. [FOCS 2024], the resulting function is a power tower of height $22$.
arxiv:2610.13270.authors: Victor A. Campos, Raul Lopes, Rodrigo Nogueira, Ignasi Sau

arxiv:2610.13279.title: Artin-Schreier curves of prescribed p-rank without extra automorphisms
arxiv:2610.13279.summary: Let p be an odd prime. We study the Artin-Schreier analogue of Poonen's problem of constructing curves without extra automorphisms. An Artin-Schreier curve carries an unavoidable deck group Cp, so the smallest possible full geometric automorphism group inside the Artin-Schreier locus is Cp.

arxiv:2610.13291.title: Geometry of some determinantal arrangements
arxiv:2610.13291.summary: Let $D_{m,n}\subset\C^{m\times n}$ be the union of the zero loci of the maximal minors of a generic $m\times n$ matrix, and let $U_{m,n}$ be its complement. We show that $U_{m,n}\cong\GL_m(\C)\times\Gr(m,n)^\circ$, where $\Gr(m,n)^\circ$ is the open stratum of the Grassmannian on which all Pl\"ucker coordinates are nonzero. For $m\in\{2,n-2\}$ this gives closed formulas for the topology of $U_{m,n}$ and recovers results of Yim.

arxiv:2610.13297.title: Critical Point Theory for the Distance Function on PL-Spaces
arxiv:2610.13297.summary: We study the (typical) singularities of the distance function from a point in the ambient space to a polytopal complex in Euclidean space. By means of the Goresky-MacPherson splitting we generalize the existing linear theory to the quadratic distance function. Critical points occur on `selected' strata of the PL-space, where normal Morse Data determine the change of topology.

arxiv:2610.13331.title: Gamma conjecture II and explicit Stokes data for a quadric projective bundle
arxiv:2610.13331.summary: We study the connection problem for the quantum differential equation of the Fano fourfold $X=\PP_{Q^3}(\OO\oplus\OO(1))$. The problem is to identify its canonical asymptotic solutions with exceptional objects and compute the associated Stokes data. We use exact Mellin--Bessel integral representations and uniform vector asymptotics on sectors wider than $\pi$, followed by analytic continuation that preserves the Gamma framing.

arxiv:2610.13339.title: Completely mobile robots in graphs with a resolving property
arxiv:2610.13339.summary: This work extends the study of mobile resolvability in connected graphs by introducing completely mobile resolving sets. As with mobile resolving sets, we consider stationing a collection of robots at the vertices in a resolving set of a graph. Robots may move one at a time to any adjacent vertex as long as set of occupied vertices remains a resolving set.
arxiv:2610.13339.authors: Jose C. Camacho Moreno, Dorota Kuziak, Ethan Shallcross, James Tuite, Ismael G. Yero

arxiv:2610.13347.title: Thurston's Legacy at the Interface of Surface Dynamics, Train Tracks, and Arithmetic
arxiv:2610.13347.summary: In this chapter, we discuss the interaction between low-dimensional dynamics, symbolic dynamics, and geometric topology, focusing on the algebraic characterization and asymptotic behaviour of stretch factors or equivalently pseudo-Anosov dilatations. We first review the algebraic foundations linking Perron--Frobenius theory, multi-variable Euclidean algorithms, and Lind's characterization of topological entropy for shifts of finite type, emphasizing recent constraints on the Perron--Frobenius degree of expansion constants. We then relate these dynamical invariants to the combinatorial world, examining train tracks for surfaces and automorphisms of free groups.

arxiv:2610.13374.title: On the fault-tolerant metric dimension of maximal outerplanar graphs
arxiv:2610.13374.summary: Given a graph $G$, a set $W$ of vertices of $G$ is a resolving set if, for any pair of vertices $z_1$ and $z_2$ of $G$, there is a vertex $w\in W$ such that $d(w,z_1)\ne d(w,z_2)$, where $d(u,v)$ denotes the length of a shortest path between the vertices $u$ and $v$. The metric dimension of a graph $G$, $\beta(G)$, is the minimum cardinality of a resolving set of $G$. A resolving set $W$ is fault-tolerant if $W\setminus \{w\}$ is a resolving set for any $w\in W$.
arxiv:2610.13374.authors: Carmen Hernando, Montserrat Maureso, Merc\`e Mora, Javier Tejel

arxiv:2610.13441.title: Deformation cones of 2-cubical combinatorial zonotopes
arxiv:2610.13441.summary: We prove that the dimension of the deformation cone of any polytope combinatorially equivalent to a 2-cubical zonotope is bounded above by the number of generators of the zonotope. This bound is tight, and we show that it cannot be improved to an identity. We further extend our results to any 2-cubical polytope whose normal fan is combinatorially isomorphic to a pseudohyperplane arrangement, but we show that it cannot be extended to arbitrary 2-cubical polytopes.
arxiv:2610.13441.authors: Juliana Curtis, Grace O'Brien, Arnau Padrol, Germain Poullot

arxiv:2610.13450.title: A complex associated to a family of ideals and applications to subspace arrangements
arxiv:2610.13450.summary: We reprove and generalize a result of Derksen describing the Hilbert polynomial of the vanishing ideal of a transversal subspace arrangement in projective space. When the subspaces have all codimension 2, we describe explicitly the local cohomology modules of the corresponding defining ideal. This is achieved via a complex naturally associated to the subspace arrangement, whose basic properties are also investigated.

arxiv:2610.13458.title: The DP color function of joins and vertex-gluing of hypergraphs
arxiv:2610.13458.summary: The DP color function $P_{DP}(\mathcal{H}, k)$ of a hypergraph $\mathcal{H}$ is defined as the minimum possible value of $P_{DP}(\mathcal{H}, \mathcal{F})$ taken over all $k$-fold covers $\mathcal{F}$ of $\mathcal{H}$. It serves as an extension of the classical chromatic polynomial. In this paper, we investigate the DP color function for two constructions: the join of a hypergraph with a complete graph and vertex-gluings of certain hypergraphs.
arxiv:2610.13458.authors: Ruiyi Cui, Liangxia Wan, Fengming Dong

arxiv:2610.13469.title: Quillen's local parameter conjecture in dimension four
arxiv:2610.13469.summary: Let $R$ be a Noetherian regular local ring of mixed characteristic and dimension four, and let $r$ be a member of a regular system of parameters. We prove that every finitely generated projective module over $R[1/r]$ is free. We also prove that $\mathrm{Sp}_4(R[1/r])$ acts transitively on unimodular columns of length four and that every determinant orientation of a rank-two projective module is induced by a basis.

arxiv:2610.13487.title: On the probability that a random Latin square is all-even
arxiv:2610.13487.summary: In a Latin square, every row can be interpreted as a permutation, and therefore has a parity (even or odd). We prove that in a uniformly random $n\times n$ Latin square, the probability that all rows are even is of the form $2^{-n+o(n)}$. This fills a gap left by recent work of Kwan, Petrova and Sawhney: they proved that the row parities behave like a sequence of independent coin flips in a variety of different senses, but they were not able to lower-bound the all-even probability, as their approach had a small number of "exceptional rows" whose parities they could not control.
arxiv:2610.13487.authors: Catherine Greenhill, Lenka Kopfov\'a, Matthew Kwan, Kalina Petrova

arxiv:2610.13488.title: Reconstruction of graphs and surfaces from derived categories
arxiv:2610.13488.summary: A pair of topological spaces $X$ and $Y$ is a \emph{Fourier--Mukai (FM) pair} if there is an equivalence of $\infty$-categories of derived sheaves of abelian groups \[\operatorname{Shv}(X;\mathrm D(\mathbb Z))\simeq \operatorname{Shv}(Y;\mathrm D(\mathbb Z)).\] An FM pair $(X,Y)$ is \emph{non-trivial} if $X$ and $Y$ are not homeomorphic. We consider the question of whether non-trivial FM pairs $(X,Y)$ exist for which $X$ and $Y$ are both "nice" spaces, which in this article means admitting a triangulation. We show that the answer is no if $X$ is second-countable and either (i) one-dimensional, (ii) a surface, or (iii) the 3-sphere.

arxiv:2610.13518.title: Asymptotic Analysis of Discrete-Time Self-Attention Dynamics in Transformers
arxiv:2610.13518.summary: In machine learning, a self-attention dynamics describes the attention mechanism of transformers, and is obtained treating the layer index of a transformer as time index. Even though naturally discrete-time, this dynamical system is most often studied in continuous-time. Scope of this paper is to provide a thorough investigation of the discrete-time version of the self-attention dynamics: a complete classification of its equilibria is given, and their stability properties are studied, in both the single-head and the multihead case.

arxiv:2610.13528.title: Campana strong approximation on generalised Markoff surfaces
arxiv:2610.13528.summary: For every smooth projective generalised Markoff surface $X_m$, every hyperplane section $H$, and every integer $n\ge2$, we establish Campana strong approximation with the Brauer--Manin obstruction for $\bigl(X_m,(1-1/n)H\bigr)$.

arxiv:2610.13530.title: Quadratic-size Random Permutations are Universal
arxiv:2610.13530.summary: A permutation is $n$-universal if it contains every permutation of length $n$ as a pattern. We prove that a uniformly random permutation of length $32n^2$ is $n$-universal with probability at least $1-\exp(-c n/\log n)$, for an absolute constant $c>0$ and all sufficiently large $n$. This removes a $\log\log n$ factor from an earlier result of He and Kwan~\cite{He-Kwan} and resolves an open problem of Alon~\cite{Alon2016}.

arxiv:2610.13551.title: Spectral Theory and Descriptive Combinatorics for Non-Regular Borel pmp Graphs
arxiv:2610.13551.summary: We continue the systematic study initiated in arXiv:2602.05185 of the relationship between the spectral theory and descriptive combinatorics of bounded-degree Borel pmp graphs, particularly in the non-regular setting. We first adapt a classical result of Nikiforov to give a new spectral lower bound on the approximate measurable chromatic number. For certain non-regular graphs, this bound improves on the approximate measurable version of Hoffman's classical bound established in arXiv:2602.05185.
arxiv:2610.13551.authors: Cecelia Higgins, Pieter Spaas, Sofia Torelli

arxiv:2610.13556.title: Disjoint unions and fixed-parameter algorithms for chromatic villainy
arxiv:2610.13556.summary: Chromatic villainy is the maximum, over rearrangements of optimal graph colorings, of the minimum Hamming distance to a proper coloring with the same color multiplicities. Weak villainy allows the repair to change these multiplicities. We give exact composition laws for disjoint unions and determine the eventual growth under repetition.
arxiv:2610.13556.authors: Jiang Jiang, Yuhan Jiang, Yiyang Li, Lujia Wang, Aitao Zhang

arxiv:2610.13580.title: Exact and extremal values of chromatic villainy
arxiv:2610.13580.summary: Chromatic villainy measures the largest number of vertices that must change color to repair a rearrangement of an optimal coloring while preserving every color multiplicity. Weak villainy allows different multiplicities in the repair.
