Our experiments cover perfect state transfer on the hypercubes $Q_2 = C_4$ and $Q_3$, and on the Hamming-weighted paths $\mathrm{HP}_n$, the…

arxiv:2610.20890.title: Path Covering Spaces of Posets
arxiv:2610.20890.summary: In this paper we extend results concerning a kind of covering space for finite posets that bears some analogy to the topological theory of covering spaces. Previous work focused on ranked, locally-finite posets with a unique minimal element. In this previous work the notion of a covering space based on preservation of path weights was defined, and it was shown that, given a poset, there is a unique universal covering space which has an explicit description.

arxiv:2610.20899.title: Ehrhart Polynomials of Triangles in $\mathbb{R}^3$
arxiv:2610.20899.summary: We present two ways of constructing Ehrhart polynomials corresponding to certain triangles in $\mathbb{R}^3$. One of our methods employs Popoviciu's Theorem, while the other method uses a version of Pick's Theorem adapted to rank-2 lattices in $\mathbb{R}^3$. We then apply our methods to linear Diophantine equations of the form $ax+by+cz=n$ and develop upper and lower bounds on the number of solutions in nonnegative integers $x$, $y$, and $z$.
arxiv:2610.20899.authors: Max Aldrich, Daniel Gulbrandsen, Clara Keddy

arxiv:2610.20932.title: Resolutions of orbifold generalised triangle groups
arxiv:2610.20932.summary: Let $T=\langle f,g\mid f^{l}=g^{m}=W^{n}=1\rangle$ be a generalised triangle group in which $W$ is the Farey word of a rational slope $q=r/s$, and suppose that $T$ is the fundamental group of a hyperbolic $3$-orbifold whose singular locus has no spherical vertices. Let $G=\langle f,g\mid f^{l}=g^{m}=W^{n}\rangle$ be the associated central extension. We compute an explicit free resolution of the trivial module over $\mathbb{Z}G$ of minimal length, with differentials given in closed form by Fox derivatives.
arxiv:2610.20932.authors: Sean P. Carroll, Thomas Csizmadia, Jeroen Schillewaert

arxiv:2610.20946.title: Emergence of partially hyperbolic skew-products with circle fibers
arxiv:2610.20946.summary: We study the statistical behavior of partially hyperbolic skew-products over Axiom A diffeomorphisms using emergence. Generically, these systems satisfy the Palis conjecture: they have a finite number of physical measures whose basins together have full volume. In particular, for Lebesgue almost every point, the empirical measures converge to one of finitely many physical measures.

arxiv:2610.20956.title: Duality Theory for Sequent Algebras
arxiv:2610.20956.summary: Sequent algebras were introduced by D. Vakarelov \cite{VakarelovSequentALg} as a generalization of contact algebras, replacing the binary contact relation with a relation between finite sets of regions and regions. In this paper, we present sequent algebras as Boolean algebras endowed with a finitary closure operator satisfying four conditions.

arxiv:2610.20991.title: Normal complex surface singularities with rational homology disk smoothings
arxiv:2610.20991.summary: We prove that a normal surface singularity whose minimal good resolution graph has at least two nodes does not admit a rational homology disk smoothing. Together with the earlier graph classifications and the analytic classifications of Fowler and Wahl, this gives a complete classification of normal surface singularities admitting rational homology disk smoothings and proves Wahl's conjecture. The same argument also proves Wahl's Rational Conjecture.
arxiv:2610.20991.authors: M\'arton Beke, Heesang Park, Dongsoo Shin, Andr\'as I. Stipsicz

arxiv:2610.21010.title: Operator Algebraic Quantum Hypergroups
arxiv:2610.21010.summary: We develop a theory of operator algebraic quantum hypergroups and their representations, formulated using a special case of the algebraic quantum hypergroup framework of van Daele and Delvaux. As part of the axioms, every operator algebraic quantum hypergroup admits a dual object of the same type. We prove that a certain universal completion in the compact case satisfies the axioms of an earlier notion of a compact quantum hypergroup in the sense of the second author and Chapovsky.

arxiv:2610.21017.title: Crossing numbers of simplicial complexes
arxiv:2610.21017.summary: This paper studies crossing numbers of $d$-dimensional simplicial complexes drawn in $\mathbb R^{2d}$ or $\mathbb S^{2d}$. We clarify and generalize a number of known results and conjectures from the graph case to higher dimensions: the crossing lemma (including the exceptional case of two-dimensional complexes drawn in dimension $4$), a generalized Harary-Hill conjecture (and evidence for it), existence of a midrange crossing constant (in a weak sense), and upper bound constructions based on stochastic geometry (related to Sylvester's problem) and the cyclic polytope. Some of our results are new even in the case of graphs: we give a simple proof of the Harary-Hill conjecture for antipodal…
arxiv:2610.21017.authors: Alfredo Hubard, Cheikh Saliou Ndiaye, Oriol Sol\'e-Pi

arxiv:2610.21036.title: Linear bounds for rich-neighbor edge-colorings
arxiv:2610.21036.summary: An edge in a proper edge-coloring is rich if all edges adjacent to it receive pairwise distinct colors. A rich-neighbor edge-coloring is a proper edge-coloring in which every non-isolated edge is adjacent to a rich edge. The rich-neighbor chromatic index $\rn(G)$ is the minimum number of colors in such a coloring.

arxiv:2610.21039.title: Holomorphy rings and the Nullstellensatz over large fields
arxiv:2610.21039.summary: For an infinite field $K$ and an ideal $I\subseteq K[X_1,\dots,X_n]$, let $J(Z_K(I))$ be the ideal of polynomials vanishing on the $K$-rational zero locus of $I$. A Nullstellensatz over $K$ is an algebraic description of this closure operator on ideals. Hilbert's classical theorem provides such a description via the radical of $I$ over any algebraically closed field.
arxiv:2610.21039.authors: Pablo Cubides Kovacsics, Sebasti\'an Uribe Rinc\'on

arxiv:2610.21049.title: SALTO: Solver-Anchored Lifted Transfer Operators for Nonlinear Event Inference
arxiv:2610.21049.summary: Learned dynamical models can accurately predict trajectories while producing unreliable sensitivities when differentiated or transposed, limiting their use in inverse problems and scientific decision-making. Classical adjoints provide exact local derivatives, but a single adjoint cannot represent the nonlinear response of a system to a family of finite-amplitude perturbations. We introduce SALTO (Solver-Anchored Lifted Transfer Operators), a Koopman-based framework for inferring finite-amplitude sources.

arxiv:2610.21051.title: A counterexample to a conjecture of Plotnick on knot exteriors
arxiv:2610.21051.summary: We resolve a conjecture of S. Plotnick from 1983 concerning the homotopy type of four-dimensional knot complements. We show that the exteriors of two branched twist spins of the trefoil, which were shown by Plotnick not to be homotopy equivalent as boundary pairs and hence not homeomorphic, are in fact simple homotopy equivalent.

arxiv:2610.21053.title: Coefficient lifting for skew divided differences and triple Schubert coefficients
arxiv:2610.21053.summary: Skew divided difference operators \(\partial_{w/v}\), introduced by Macdonald, play an important role in the study of Schubert polynomials and their structure constants. For permutations \(u,v,w\in S_n\), we show that the coefficient of each monomial \(\xx^\alpha\) in \(\partial_{w/v}\SSch_u(\xx;\yy)\), where \(\SSch_u(\xx;\yy)\) is the double Schubert polynomial, is a single triple Schubert coefficient evaluated at \(\tb=0\), whose indices form an explicit lift of \((u,v,w)\) to \(S_{n+\abs{\alpha}}\). As an application, we show that every coefficient of \(\partial_{w/v}\SSch_u(\xx)\) is a single Schubert structure constant.

arxiv:2610.21065.title: A $p$-adic Riemann--Hilbert correspondence over Robba rings
arxiv:2610.21065.summary: We construct overconvergent period sheaves $\mathcal{O}\widetilde{\mathbb{C}}^{I,\dagger}$ and $\mathcal{O}\mathbb{B}_{\mathrm{dR}}^{\dagger,+}$ on the $v$-site of a liftable semi-stable formal scheme $\mathfrak{X}_Z$. By establishing a decompletion theorem for small representations, we prove a $p$-adic Riemann-Hilbert correspondence relating small $\widetilde{\mathbb{C}}^I$-local systems (resp. $\mathbb{B}_{\mathrm{dR}}^+$-local systems) on the generic fiber $X_Z$ to small flat connections on the associated period ringed spaces.
arxiv:2610.21065.authors: Zekun Chen, Ruochuan Liu, Yupeng Wang, Jiahong Yu, Xinwen Zhu

arxiv:2610.21083.title: Exotic diffeomorphisms on closed aspherical $4$-manifolds
arxiv:2610.21083.summary: We study a class of diffeomorphisms of closed manifolds obtained from Davis' reflection trick construction, which are obtained by reflecting a diffeomorphism supported in the fundamental chamber of such a manifold. We use this construction to exhibit the first examples of closed aspherical $4$-manifolds with diffeomorphisms that are topologically isotopic to the identity map, but not smoothly isotopic to it.
arxiv:2610.21083.authors: Hokuto Konno, Jianfeng Lin, Anubhav Mukherjee, Juan Mu\~noz-Ech\'aniz

arxiv:2610.21092.title: Positivity of Wahl defects and representations from index-one covers
arxiv:2610.21092.summary: Let \((X,E) \to (V,0)\) be the minimal good resolution of a normal complex surface singularity, with \(E\) reduced. The Wahl defect is \(\Delta(V,0) :=h^1(\mathcal{O}_X)-h^1(S_X)+h^1(\bigwedge^2 S_X)\), where \(S_X=\Theta_X(-\log E)\). For non-Gorenstein \(\mathbb{Q}\)-Gorenstein singularities \((V,0)\), we prove that \(\Delta(V,0)\geq0\), with equality precisely in the quasi-homogeneous case.

arxiv:2610.21093.title: Nonlinear neighborhoods of smooth curves and arbitrarily negative Wahl defects
arxiv:2610.21093.summary: We develop a theory of nonlinear neighborhoods of smooth projective curves of genus at least two, constructed by gluing products of open subsets of a curve with a disc using nonlinear changes of the disc coordinate. Their zero sections have normal bundles of negative degree and contract to normal surface singularities. For the minimal good resolution \((X,E) \to (V,0)\) of a normal complex surface singularity other than a rational double point, the Wahl defect is defined by \(\Delta(V,0) := h^1(\mathcal{O}_X)-h^1(S_X)+h^1(\bigwedge^2S_X)\), where \(E\) is reduced and \(S_X = \Theta_X(-\log E)\).

arxiv:2610.21097.title: Decomposing multigraphs into two Class I subgraphs with prescribed maximum degrees
arxiv:2610.21097.summary: Let $G$ be a finite loopless multigraph with maximum degree $\Delta$ and $\chi'(G)=\Delta+k$, where $k\ge0$. We prove that for every pair of positive integers $p,q$ satisfying $$p+q=\Delta+k\qquad\text{and}\qquad p,q\le\Delta,$$ the graph $G$ admits an edge decomposition into two spanning Class I subgraphs $H_p,H_q$ with $$\Delta(H_p)=p \qquad\text{and}\qquad \Delta(H_q)=q.$$

arxiv:2610.21100.title: Non-simply connected Poincar\'e surgery
arxiv:2610.21100.summary: We give homotopy-theoretic proofs of the principal results of non-simply connected Poincar\'e surgery. These include the Fundamental Theorem of Poincar\'e surgery, the Poincar\'e transversality exact sequence, and the construction of Poincar\'e handle structures. All results apply in dimensions~$\ge 8$.

arxiv:2610.21102.title: Quantum Color Newton Rings
arxiv:2610.21102.summary: We study integral Newton rings attached to symmetric quantum colors. We show that their boundary values at a deleted node are exactly the elements of Habiro's cyclotomic completion, and we describe their quantum neighborhoods at $q=1$ uniformly in the rank. The symmetric-color $\mathfrak{sl}_n$ invariants of a knot are the values of an element of such a ring.

arxiv:2610.21141.title: Random Quotients of Hyperbolic Spaces with Respect to WPD Actions and Linear Connectivity of the Boundary
arxiv:2610.21141.summary: We study random quotients of acylindrically hyperbolic groups and hierchically hyperbolic groups, whose (partial) hyperbolicity is captured by their actions on Gromov hyperbolic spaces. We show that if an acylindrically hyperbolic group $G$ acts on a Gromov hyperbolic space $X$ coarsely transitively with a WPD element, then the quotient of $X$ by the normal closure of a random element of $G$ has linearly connected boundary. If $G$ is a group with a (relative) hierarchically hyperbolic group structure, with a quasi-tree top domain $X$, then in fact the quotient of $X$ by the normal closure of a random element of $G$ has boundary homeomorphic to the N\"obeling curve.

arxiv:2610.21153.title: Holomorphic Triangles in the Heegaard Floer Pillowcase
arxiv:2610.21153.summary: The Heegaard Floer pillowcase is a recurring local model for rational tangle replacement and exact-triangle constructions. We compute the triangle product for its standard rational-slope triples of curves and encode all contributing classes in a finite generating polynomial. One slope ordering gives a vanishing map.

arxiv:2610.21175.title: Conditional limit laws for open intermittent dynamics
arxiv:2610.21175.summary: We obtain conditional limit theorems for open intermittent Liverani-Saussol-Vaienti (LSV) maps. Unlike the results of closed systems (e.g. some uniformly expanding maps), we obtain a new limit distribution, which is different from the Gaussian law or the stable law, for both "regular" and singular observables.

arxiv:2610.21198.title: Understanding entropy using Aubin--Yau deformations
arxiv:2610.21198.summary: In this paper we investigate three types of entropy that frequently appear in the research of K\"ahler geometry: the classical K\"ahler entropy, the radial entropy and the non-Archimedean entropy. We give a unifying interpretation for these entropies by showing that they can all be expressed as the derivative of the Monge--Amp\`ere energy along certain Aubin--Yau type deformations. Such considerations also lead to a novel algebraic criterion for the existence of constant scalar curvature K\"ahler metrics.

arxiv:2610.21210.title: Local modifications in planar hypohamiltonian graphs
arxiv:2610.21210.summary: We prove that for $n \geq 36$ there exists a planar hypohamiltonian graph of order $n$. As a corollary, we prove that for $n \geq 33$ there exists an almost hypohamiltonian planar graph of order $n$. Further, we exhibit over 100 planar hypohamiltonian graphs of order less than 40, including new graphs of orders 36, 37, 38, and 39.
arxiv:2610.21210.authors: Samantha Durias, Sabrina Guerrero, Briana Jaiyen, Daniel Kaplan, Austin Lapine, Caleb Peralta, Akul Shrivastav

arxiv:2610.21217.title: Strong Lefschetz property of the Kirchhoff algebra of the complete tripartite graph $K_{1,1,n}$
arxiv:2610.21217.summary: By Whitney's 2-isomorphism theorem, the cycle matroids of two graphs are isomorphic if and only if one graph can be transformed into the other by finitely many applications of two operations: separation or identification at a cut-vertex, and twisting. The complete tripartite graph whose vertex set is the disjoint union of two singletons and an $n$-element set is invariant, up to isomorphism, under these operations. In this paper we prove that the Macaulay inverse system (the Kirchhoff algebra) determined by the basis generating polynomial of the cycle matroid of such a graph has the strong Lefschetz property over a field of characteristic $0$.

arxiv:2610.21247.title: Semisimplicity and Rigidity of the Kontsevich--Zorich Cocycle for Products of Strata
arxiv:2610.21247.summary: We study the Kontsevich--Zorich cocycle, its fixed tensor constructions, and their finite direct sums over products of strata of Abelian differentials. The acting groups are closed subgroups $G\subset(\mathrm{SL}_2\mathbb R)^n$ that, up to factor permutations and coordinatewise conjugation by rotations, are products of diagonal $\mathrm{SL}_2\mathbb R$ blocks and a finite central group. For ergodic invariant probability measures, we prove Deligne-type semisimplicity: the bundles admit Hodge-compatible decompositions into $G$-invariant pieces $V_i\otimes_{A_i}W_i$, where $A_i$ are division algebras, $V_i$ carry pure variations of Hodge structure, and the multiplicity spaces $W_i$ carry…

arxiv:2610.21263.title: The Rate of the Delsarte Bound for Binary Codes and Spheres
arxiv:2610.21263.summary: We give the asymptotic rate of Delsarte's linear programming bound for binary codes and spherical codes. This extends previous work of the author which formulated and proved an analogue of the conjecture of Afkhami-Jeddi, Cohn, Hartman, de Laat, and Tajdini for binary codes, obtaining the rate of the Delsarte linear program at distance $1/2-1/\pi$. The lower bounds introduce ideas from potential theory into the study of Delsarte's bounds, whereby the measures underlying a system of orthogonal polynomials give an obstacle problem.

arxiv:2610.21265.title: Local Extrema and Infinite Derivatives of the Delange Function of Base 3
arxiv:2610.21265.summary: In the ternary Hamming cube $Q_n^3$, the smallest number $\xi_n(m)$ of edges leaving a set of $m$ vertices is $2(nm-S_3(m))$, where $S_3(m)=\sum_{j<m}s_3(j)$ and $s_3$ is the ternary digit sum. After rescaling, these numbers are the values at the points $m/3^n$ of a continuous function $T$ of Takagi type, the Delange function of base $3$. Both facts are known.

arxiv:2610.21271.title: Beyond 11/16: dense Kuramoto networks that resist synchrony
arxiv:2610.21271.summary: How densely must a network of identical Kuramoto oscillators be wired before synchrony is its only stable state? The answer is a critical connectivity $\mu_c$ (the minimum degree divided by $n-1$), known to satisfy $11/16\le\mu_c<3/4$. We raise the lower bound from $11/16=0.6875$ to $\mu_c\ge(4+2q^*)/(7+q^*)=0.6929077\ldots$, where $q^*\approx0.6506$ is a root of an explicit polynomial of degree 8.

arxiv:2610.21272.title: A refinement of the strange duality conjecture on K3 surfaces
arxiv:2610.21272.summary: Let $v,w$ be primitive Mukai vectors of positive rank on a polarized K3 surface with $\chi(v\otimes w)=0$. Marian and Oprea conjectured that the strange duality map $H^0(M(v),\Theta_w)^\vee\to H^0(M(w),\Theta_v)$ is either zero or an isomorphism. We give three families of counterexamples to this conjecture.

arxiv:2610.21280.title: Unbounded Nilpotency Gaps on Rationally Elliptic Manifolds
arxiv:2610.21280.summary: We construct simply connected, closed smooth manifolds whose rational homotopy types are elliptic and whose homology nilpotency exceeds rational category by arbitrarily large amounts. This separates short models from short quotients of minimal models. The construction starts from an explicit family of minimal Sullivan algebras with finite-dimensional cohomology.

arxiv:2610.21289.title: A universal framework for Hopf algebras in combinatorics
arxiv:2610.21289.summary: A universal framework for Hopf algebras in combinatorics provides a unified understanding of combinatorial objects. To establish such a framework, we dualize the theory of combinatorial Hopf algebras developed by Aguiar, Bergeron, and Sottile, obtaining the category of rooted Hopf algebras. An object in this category is a graded connected Hopf algebra equipped with a group-like element, called a root, in its completion.

arxiv:2610.21303.title: Asymptotics of the Moduli Spaces of Parabolic $\mathrm{SL}(3,\mathbb C)$-Higgs Bundles
arxiv:2610.21303.summary: We study the large-scale geometry of the moduli spaces of stable strongly parabolic $\mathrm{SL}(3,\C)$-Higgs bundles on the three-punctured sphere for a family of parabolic weights. We glue the local Toda model metric to a decoupled metric obtained from the spectral line bundle, and perturb the resulting approximate metrics to harmonic metrics adapted to the parabolic structure. We also prove that Hitchin's $L^2$ metric approaches the semi-flat metric exponentially.

arxiv:2610.21326.title: Critical Ising Model on the Periodic Cubic Lattice $(\mathbb{Z}/L\mathbb{Z})^{3}$
arxiv:2610.21326.summary: We investigate the critical behaviour of the nearest-neighbour Ising model on the three-dimensional periodic cubic lattice $(\mathbb{Z}/L\mathbb{Z})^{3}$, and we present a companion set of Monte Carlo simulations. After recalling the rigorous results on the continuity of the spontaneous magnetization in $d=3$ and the triviality of the scaling limit in $d\ge 4$, we compile modern high-precision estimates of the 3D Ising critical exponents and verify the scaling relations that connect them. We then describe numerical measurements of the Binder cumulant, the magnetic susceptibility, the specific heat, the two-point correlation function, and the finite-size scaling of the magnetization.

arxiv:2610.21341.title: Matrix Completion Discriminants
arxiv:2610.21341.summary: We introduce the matrix completion discriminant of a graph as the Zariski closure of the set of partial symmetric matrices whose completion fibers fail to meet a rank stratum transversely. A clique-sum formula for the matrix completion discriminant is established for arbitrary graphs, while explicit defining equations for cycles are obtained in terms of iterated resultants. Using these results together with the analysis of $K_4$-minor-free graphs, we prove that for every cycle-completable graph, the discriminant factors into determinant factors from maximal cliques and resultant factors from chordless cycles.

arxiv:2610.21358.title: Fundamental Groups and Coregularity: Klt Pairs with Trivial and Nef Log-Anticanonical Class
arxiv:2610.21358.summary: In this article, we study how the absolute coregularity of a projective log pair reflects on its fundamental group. More precisely, we show that for a projective klt log pair $(X,D)$ of absolute coregularity $c$ and arbitrary dimension the fundamental group $\pi_1^{\rm reg}(X,D)$ admits a normal abelian subgroup of finite index and rank at most $2c$. We reduce this statement to klt Calabi-Yau pairs with standard coefficients of dimension $c$.

arxiv:2610.21365.title: Anti-successors and anti-replicators, Manin products and Koszul duality
arxiv:2610.21365.summary: We develop an operadic theory of anti-splitting and anti-replication for binary operads. For a binary operad $\opd$, we define its anti-bisuccessor $\ABSu(\opd)$ and anti-trisuccessor $\ATSu(\opd)$, with the property that an operation of $\opd$ splits into a negative sum of two or three operations, yielding canonical operad morphisms $\opd \to\ABSu(\opd)$ and $\opd\to\ATSu(\opd)$. For binary quadratic operads, the process gives Manin black products, \[ \ABSu(\opd) \cong \antiprelie \bullet \opd, \qquad \ATSu(\opd)\cong \antipostlie\bullet\opd.
arxiv:2610.21365.authors: Chengming Bai, Li Guo, Yunhe Sheng, You Wang

arxiv:2610.21381.title: Optimally large cuts in both directions
arxiv:2610.21381.summary: We prove that for every integer $d\ge2$ and all sufficiently large $m$, every digraph with $m$ edges and minimum outdegree at least $d$ has a vertex bipartition for which each directed cut is of size at least \[\left\lceil\frac{d-1}{2(2d-1)}m+\frac{d^2}{2(2d-1)}\right\rceil.\] The bound is sharp for infinitely many $m$. This answers for large graphs a question of Scott and proves a conjecture of Lee, Loh, and Sudakov. For $d=2$ we prove that $\lceil m/6\rceil$ is achievable for all $m$.

arxiv:2610.21388.title: Stronger Spectral Bound for Clique Number
arxiv:2610.21388.summary: Given an integer $k$, deciding whether a graph has a clique of size $k$ is an NP-complete problem. Wilf's inequality provides a spectral lower bound for the clique number of a graph. Strengthening this bound, Elphick and Wocjan proposed a conjecture in 2018 using positive adjacency eigenvalues.
arxiv:2610.21388.authors: Hareshkumar Jadav, Sudipta Mallik, Akhilesh Panchangam, Ranveer Singh

arxiv:2610.21415.title: Ordinary lines, point degrees, and matroid density
arxiv:2610.21415.summary: For every set of $n$ points in $\mathbb{C}^d$ with full affine span, we prove that some point lies on at least $n+1-2n/(d+1)$ spanned lines, which is best possible in every dimension. By successive contraction, this implies the sharp bound $r+(\ell-3)\binom r2$ on the number of elements of a simple rank-$r$ complex-representable matroid excluding $U_{2,\ell}$ as a minor, which removes the sufficiently-large-rank assumption from the bound of Geelen, Nelson, and Walsh. An arithmetic application shows that rank-$r$ integer matrices whose maximal minors have absolute value at most $\Delta$ have at most $O(\Delta r^2)$ distinct columns, resolving a question of Averkov and Schymura.

arxiv:2610.21446.title: Good stratifications of non-degenerate locally tame complete intersection varieties
arxiv:2610.21446.summary: In this paper, we show that non-degenerate locally tame complete intersection varieties admit good stratifications. As an application, we study variation of the Milnor fibrations in pencils associated with non-degenerate hypersurface singularities.

arxiv:2610.21454.title: Curvature-Distortion Numbers of Graphs: Prescribed Lin--Lu--Yau Curvature Lower Bounds
arxiv:2610.21454.summary: We study an optimization problem for weighted Lin--Lu--Yau curvature. Given a graph $G=(V,E)$ and a prescribed lower curvature bound $k\ge0$, we ask for the smallest multiplicative distortion \[ \Dist(w):=\frac{\sup_{e\in E}w_e}{\inf_{e\in E}w_e} \] of the edge weights needed to make every edge have curvature at least $k$. This leads to the family \[ \DN_{\LLY}^{k}(G) := \inf\bigl\{ \Dist(w): \kappa_{\LLY}^{w}(e)\ge k \text{ for every }e\in E(G) \bigr\}, \] which extends the nonnegative-curvature invariant introduced in our preceding paper \cite{Xia2026InvariantI}.

arxiv:2610.21497.title: Complete homogeneous varieties over a field
arxiv:2610.21497.summary: The main objects of this paper are complete homogeneous varieties under the action of a semisimple group $G$ over field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$. When the isotropy groups of the geometric points are smooth parabolics, these are classically known as twisted flag varieties and are well studied in the literature. If the smoothness assumption is removed, we get a larger class of varieties which we call as \emph{twisted parabolic varieties}.
arxiv:2610.21497.authors: Michel Brion, Matilde Maccan, Srinivasan Srimathy

arxiv:2610.21501.title: Ehrhart positivity for paving positroids
arxiv:2610.21501.summary: A central conjecture of Ferroni, Jochemko, and Schr\"{o}ter posits that every positroid is Ehrhart positive. While Ehrhart positivity has recently been verified for notable classes such as lattice path matroids and series-parallel matroids, the general conjecture remains open. In this paper, we prove that the base polytope of any paving positroid has positive Ehrhart coefficients.

arxiv:2610.21506.title: Strong coloring numbers of grids
arxiv:2610.21506.summary: For positive integers $n$ and $d$, the $d$-dimensional grid of side length $n$ is the graph $G(n,d)$ with vertex set $[n]^d$, in which two vertices are adjacent if they differ by $1$ in exactly one coordinate and agree in all the other coordinates. We determine, for every fixed $d$, the asymptotic growth in $r$ of the $r$th strong coloring numbers of these grids. More precisely for $n$ large enough, ${\rm scol}_r(G(n,d)) = \Omega_d\bigl(r^{d-1}\bigr)$ as $r\to\infty$.

arxiv:2610.21507.title: A Krause-type recollement for Q-shaped derived categories
arxiv:2610.21507.summary: Let k be a commutative noetherian hereditary ring and let Q be a small, Hom-finite, locally bounded k-linear category admitting a Serre functor and satisfying the strong retraction property, with nilpotent pseudo-radical. For every k-algebra A, we construct a recollement of the Q-shaped homo?topy category KQ(A Inj) of objectwise injective Q-shaped modules by its full subcategory Kac Q (A Inj) of exact objects and the Q-shaped derived category DQ(A). The construction uses complete hereditary cotorsion pairs and does not require A to be noetherian.

arxiv:2610.21516.title: Algorithms for computing basins of attraction associated with a rational self-map of the Hopf fibration based on Lyapunov exponents
arxiv:2610.21516.summary: The objective of this work is twofold. One, we develop a theory of iteration for complex rational functions so that the problems of overflow and indeterminacy caused by null, or almost null, denominators can be avoided when developing implementations. Second, we present easily implementable methods that allow the calculation of attracting cycles as well as the graphical representation of their basins of attraction.
arxiv:2610.21516.authors: V. \'Alvarez-Aparicio, J. M. Garc\'{\i}a-Calcines, L. J. Hern\'andez-Paricio, M. T. Rivas-Rodr\'{\i}guez

arxiv:2610.21529.title: Frey-Mazur theorem for semistable elliptic curves over function fields
arxiv:2610.21529.summary: Let $k$ be a field, let $B/k$ be a smooth projective geometrically integral curve, and put $K=k(B)$. We prove a Frey--Mazur type theorem for nonisotrivial semistable elliptic curves over $K$. More precisely, after fixing the genus of $B$ and the characteristic of $k$, a sufficiently large prime-to-characteristic torsion representation determines the $K$-isogeny class.

arxiv:2610.21535.title: Rectangular Symmetry for Catalan Functions
arxiv:2610.21535.summary: Katabolizable tableaux provide a combinatorial formula for the Schur coefficients of Catalan functions. We prove that a tableau involution preserves katabolizability under antidiagonal reflection of any upper root ideal. This involution complements shape and content in a fixed rectangle and preserves charge.

arxiv:2610.21544.title: On the variety of sum of powers of certain complete intersection forms
arxiv:2610.21544.summary: Let $F$ be a homogeneous polynomial (form). If the annihilator ideal $F^\perp$ is a complete intersection, then $F$ is called as a complete intersection form. For many complete intersection forms, we show that its minimal apolar ideal is a complete intersection and further we show that ${\rm VSP}(F)$ is irreducible and compute its dimension.

arxiv:2610.21559.title: Density of repelling periodic points for cubic rational maps
arxiv:2610.21559.summary: We prove the repelling-density conjecture for cubic rational maps over $\mathbf C_p$: for every prime $p$, the classical Julia set is the closure of the classical repelling periodic points. By B\'ezivin's theorem, it suffices to prove that a nonempty classical Julia set contains a classical repelling periodic point. The case $p\geq5$ follows from known results for tame maps, so we treat residue characteristics two and three.

arxiv:2610.21572.title: Lattice coverings by parallelotopes containing cube vertices
arxiv:2610.21572.summary: We investigate when a parallelotope containing vertices of the unit cube $Q_n=[0,1]^n$ covers $\Bbb R^n$ by integer translates. We prove the covering property for every parallelepiped containing five vertices of $Q_3$, and, in any dimension, for every parallelotope containing a facet of $Q_n$ and one vertex of the opposite facet. As a consequence, we obtain the sharp bound $1/n$ for the volume of a pyramid contained in $Q_n$ with a parallelotope base.

arxiv:2610.21577.title: Generalized Erd\H{o}s--Ginzburg--Ziv Constants for finite abelian groups of rank three
arxiv:2610.21577.summary: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group with exponent $\exp(G)$. For positive integer $k$, the generalized Erd\H{o}s--Ginzburg--Ziv constant, denoted by $\mathsf s_{k\exp(G)}(G)$ is the least integer $\ell$ such that every sequence of length at least $\ell$ over $G$ has a zero-sum subsequence of length $k\exp(G)$. In this paper, we prove that, for any $n\ge 1$, \[\mathsf s_{3\cdot 2^n}(C_{2^n}^3)=6\cdot 2^n-3 \quad\text{and}\quad \mathsf s_{4\cdot 3^n}(C_{3^n}^3)=7\cdot 3^n-3.

arxiv:2610.21585.title: Augmentation curve for torus knots
arxiv:2610.21585.summary: We prove a version of topological recursion for the correlation differentials of colored HOMFLY-PT polynomials of torus knots on the corresponding augmentation curves, following the proposal of Gu, Jockers, Klemm, and Soroush. To this end, we explicitly construct the spectral curve from the so-called auxiliary curve of Brini, Eynard, and Mari\~no and prove that it coincides with the augmentation curve for every torus knot with coprime $(r,s)$. Finally, our version of topological recursion proves the higher-genus closed-string prediction of the Aganagic--Vafa conjecture for all torus knot augmentation curves.

arxiv:2610.21593.title: Star-Ordered Rotor Loops in Clifford Algebras
arxiv:2610.21593.summary: We consider, in a real Clifford algebra, a family of unit bivectors $B_i = C S_i$ formed from $k+1$ pairwise anticommuting generators $C, S_1, \ldots, S_k$ with square $-1$; we call this a \emph{star family} with \emph{central generator} $C$ and \emph{leaf generators} $S_i$. For the associated rotors $U_i(\theta_i) = \cos\frac{\theta_i}{2} + B_i \sin\frac{\theta_i}{2}$ we study two objects: the ordered chain $P_k = U_1 \cdots U_k$ and the \emph{star-ordered rotor loop} $\Theta_k = P_k \, Q_k$ with the \emph{same-order reversion product} $Q_k = \widetilde U_1 \cdots \widetilde U_k$, as opposed to the trivially reversed order, for which $U_1 \cdots U_k \widetilde U_k \cdots \widetilde U_1 =…

arxiv:2610.21599.title: Persistence in probability for stochastic delay equations with multiplicative noise
arxiv:2610.21599.summary: We study the stochastic delay equation \begin{equation*} dX(t)=[-\gamma X(t)+r f(X(t-\tau))]\,dt+\sigma X(t)\,dW(t), \end{equation*} where $\gamma,r,\tau\in(0,\infty)$, $\sigma\in[0,\infty)$, and with $f$ either globally Lipschitz or globally bounded and locally Lipschitz, with $f(0)=0$ and $f(x)\ge0$ for all $x>0$. Under the condition \begin{equation*} r\liminf_{x\to 0^{+}}\frac{f(x)}{x}>\gamma+\frac{1}{2}\sigma^2, \end{equation*} independent of the time delay $\tau,$ we obtain that every solution $X$ with nonnegative initial history and $X(0)>0$ is bounded away from zero in probability. This result then confirms a recent conjecture of van den Bosch, van Gaans, and Verduyn Lunel, and…
arxiv:2610.21599.authors: Mark van den Bosch, John Ioannis Stavroulakis

arxiv:2610.21622.title: Local Tate duality for syntomic cohomology in positive characteristic
arxiv:2610.21622.summary: Let $k$ be a local field of characteristic $p>0$. We show that syntomic cohomology over $k$, with coefficients, and defined using Dodd's theory of $F$-gauges, satisfies local Tate duality. We also prove that syntomic cohomology over the ring of integers of $k$, again with coefficients, is Lagrangian with respect to the duality pairing.

arxiv:2610.21627.title: Degree Growth of Rational Maps with Laurent Property
arxiv:2610.21627.summary: Algebraic entropy measures the exponential growth of the degrees of iterates of rational self-maps. It is introduced by Bellon and Viallet in \cite{BellonandViallet}. We study degree growth for rational maps arising from recurrences with the Laurent property, with particular emphasis on Gale--Robinson recurrences.

arxiv:2610.21635.title: Pantograph Difference Equations: Stability, Multistability, and Chaos
arxiv:2610.21635.summary: Pantograph equations are functional differential equations with proportional delay, typically involving terms of the form $x(at)$, where $0<a<1$. These equations have been studied for several decades and have applications in areas ranging from number theory to electrodynamics. In this work, we investigate pantograph difference equations as discrete dynamical maps of the form \[ x_{i+1}=F(x_{i})+G(x_{h(i)}), \qquad i\geq 0, \] where $h(i)\leq i$.

arxiv:2610.21636.title: An Eventown Result for Multisets
arxiv:2610.21636.summary: We study an extension of the Eventown problem of sets to multisets on $[n] = \{1,2,...,n\}$. A multiset is called $m$-bounded if each element has multiplicity at most $m$. The intersection of two multisets is defined as the multiset in which each element has multiplicity equal to the minimum of its multiplicities in the two original multisets.

arxiv:2610.21647.title: A simple classification of the special matchings in the symmetric group
arxiv:2610.21647.summary: We establish a simple characterization of special matchings of all Bruhat intervals in the symmetric group, yielding an explicit classification that depends only on the one-line notations of the endpoints. We also study extensions of graded posets by partial special matchings, proving the existence and uniqueness of such extensions and providing an explicit construction. Combining these results, we obtain a combinatorial algorithm for computing Kazhdan--Lusztig polynomials for an isomorphism-closed family of Bruhat intervals that includes all intervals whose bottom element has length at most one.

arxiv:2610.21675.title: Equivariant $K$-theory as a global localization
arxiv:2610.21675.summary: We establish a global equivariant refinement of the theorem of Snaith that presents the complex $K$-theory spectrum as a localization of the suspension spectrum of $\mathbb C P^\infty$. We prove that the morphism of ultra-commutative global ring spectra from $\Sigma^\infty_+ B_{\text{gl}} U(1)$ that classifies the tautological $U(1)$-representation exhibits the global $K$-theory spectrum as a specific localization, in both the $\infty$-categories of ultra-commutative ring spectra and of commutative global ring spectra. The classes to be inverted are certain representation-graded $U(n)$-equivariant homotopy classes of $\Sigma^\infty_+ B_{\text{gl}} U(1)$, the pre-Bott classes.

arxiv:2610.21724.title: Graphs with three eigenvalues from group divisible designs
arxiv:2610.21724.summary: We construct biregular graphs with three distinct eigenvalues from semiregular group divisible designs. For every prime power $q$, we use the spectral structure of Muzychuk's Construction~A on $q+1$ copies of $\operatorname{AG}(2,q^2)$ to produce suitable group divisible designs. The resulting biregular graphs have $2q^5+q^4+q^2$ vertices and distinct eigenvalues $q^5+q^3+q^2$, $q^2$, and $-q^2$.

arxiv:2610.21752.title: Quotients of Calabi-Yau Generalized Fermat manifolds and Log Enriques varieties
arxiv:2610.21752.summary: Enriques manifolds and Log Enriques varieties have attracted a lot of interest in the last years. In this paper we study Enriques manifolds and Log Enriques varieties that are respectively \'etale and quasi-\'etale quotients of Calabi-Yau manifolds. We produce several examples by studying quotients of generalized Fermat manifolds of Calabi-Yau type.
arxiv:2610.21752.authors: Simone Billi, Ana Julisa Palomino, Alessandra Sarti

arxiv:2610.21762.title: The linear positive torsor presentation and arithmetic purity of strong approximation
arxiv:2610.21762.summary: In this article, we define a notion for varieties called linear positive torsor presentation. For varieties with a linear positive torsor presentation over number fields, we establish the arithmetic purity of strong approximation with the Brauer--Manin obstruction off the empty set. As a consequence, we recover arithmetic purity for smooth toric variety with no non-constant global section.

arxiv:2610.21812.title: Orlik-Solomon algebras determine the Tutte polynomials of matroids of rank at most three
arxiv:2610.21812.summary: Let $\mathcal{M}$ be a simple matroid of rank $r$ on the ground set $[n]=\{1,\ldots,n\}$, let $T_{\mathcal{M}}(x,y)$ denote its Tutte polynomial, and let $\mathrm{OS}(\mathcal{M})$ denote its Orlik-Solomon $\mathbb{C}$-algebra. We say that $\mathrm{OS}(\mathcal{M})$ determines $T_{\mathcal{M}}(x,y)$ if, for every simple matroid $\mathcal{N}$, an isomorphism $\mathrm{OS}(\mathcal{M})\cong\mathrm{OS}(\mathcal{N})$ of $\mathbb{C}$-algebras, without regard to the grading, implies $T_{\mathcal{M}}(x,y)=T_{\mathcal{N}}(x,y)$. Falk conjectured that the Orlik-Solomon $\mathbb{C}$-algebra of every simple matroid of rank three determines its Tutte polynomial.
arxiv:2610.21812.authors: Jianxuan Luo, Tingzeng Wu, Hong-Jian Lai

arxiv:2610.21822.title: Generalized Cluster Algebra Homomorphisms Induced by Cluster Tube Embeddings
arxiv:2610.21822.summary: We relate multiplication formulas for regular modules in coefficient-free acyclic affine cluster algebras with skew-symmetric exchange matrices to the imaginary exchange relations of Reading-Stella. Introducing a parameter $z$ into the construction of Zhou-Zhu, we define a weighted cluster character on cluster tubes that satisfies generalized exchange relations of type $C_{n-1}$ and yields a bijection between indecomposable rigid objects and cluster variables. Using the multiplication formulas and difference property of Ding-Xiao-Xu, we show that non-homogeneous tube embeddings induce injective homomorphisms into ordinary affine cluster algebras under $z\mapsto X_\delta$.

arxiv:2610.21838.title: The space of polarized compactifications of an affine variety
arxiv:2610.21838.summary: Let $X$ be a normal affine variety over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. Through the lens of non-Archimedean geometry, we study the space of polarized compactifications of $X$, consisting of pairs $(\bar X, D)$ where $\bar X$ is a normal projective variety containing $X$ as a dense open subset, and $D$ is an effective ample $\mathbb{Q}$-Cartier $\mathbb{Q}$-divisor with support equal to the complement of $X$ in $\bar X$. We identify this space with a natural class of functions--the Fubini--Study functions--on the Berkovich analytification of $X$.

arxiv:2610.21859.title: Weight structures and t-structures on the triangulated category generated by a $\mathbb{P}$-object
arxiv:2610.21859.summary: $\mathbb{P}$-objects were introduced by Huybrechts and Thomas as a generalization of spherical objects. We classify the weight structures and t-structures on the triangulated category generated by a $\mathbb{P}^n[k]$-object in the sense of Krug. For $n=1$, this recovers the classification of weight structures and t-structures on the triangulated category generated by a spherical object due to Holm, Jorgensen and Yang.

arxiv:2610.21866.title: Edge ideals of gapfree graphs with matching number $3$
arxiv:2610.21866.summary: We prove that if $G$ is a gapfree graph with matching number $3$, then every power $I(G)^q$, $q\geq2$, of its edge ideal has linear quotients, and hence a linear resolution. Our approach combines graph reductions based on clique domination of gapfree graphs and matching number with operations preserving linear quotients. We reduce the problem to $26$ non-co-chordal graphs on at most seven vertices.
arxiv:2610.21866.authors: Nursel Erey, T\`ai Huy H\`a, Takayuki Hibi, Selvi Kara, Susan Morey

arxiv:2610.21868.title: Rich-neighbor 5-edge-colorings of subcubic graphs whose 3-vertices induce a matching
arxiv:2610.21868.summary: Let $\varphi$ be a proper edge-coloring of a graph $G$. An edge is called rich if all edges adjacent to it receive pairwise distinct colors. The coloring $\varphi$ is a rich-neighbor edge-coloring if every non-isolated edge is adjacent to a rich edge.
arxiv:2610.21868.authors: Jiangxu Kong, Zhuming Lin, Yan Wang

arxiv:2610.21885.title: Scalar curvature, volume, and Weil-Petersson translation length
arxiv:2610.21885.summary: We construct metrics on pseudoAnosov mapping tori that make every fiber an intrinsically hyperbolic stable minimal surface, and which have scalar curvature identically -6. Using this, we give a new proof (with improved constant) of an inequality bounding the hyperbolic volume of a pseudoAnosov mapping torus by the Weil-Petersson translation length (and consequently, the entropy) of its monodromy.

arxiv:2610.21894.title: A family of algebras that connects positroids, the Theta conjecture, the Delta conjecture, and Eulerian quasisymmetric functions
arxiv:2610.21894.summary: We define a family of algebras $\mathbb{Q}[\mathbf{x}_n]/I_{n,a,b}$ whose Hilbert series, when $n\le a+b\le n+2$, $a>0$, and $0<b<n$, enumerate certain positroid cells by codimension. Equivalently, these series enumerate certain affine permutations by length. We determine the graded $\mathfrak{S}_n$-module structure of these algebras by using exact sequences to derive an invertible recursion for their graded Frobenius characteristics when $a+b\ge n$ and then passing to the limit $a\rightarrow\infty$.

arxiv:2610.21904.title: Reconstruction of Fano manifolds from the orthogonal to an exceptional vector bundle
arxiv:2610.21904.summary: Let $X$ and $Y$ be smooth complex Fano manifolds of dimension at least three with very ample anticanonical bundles and let $V_X$ and $V_Y$ be exceptional vector bundles on $X$ and $Y$, respectively. We prove that a Fourier--Mukai equivalence $V_X^\perp\simeq V_Y^\perp$ implies $X\simeq Y$.

arxiv:2610.21921.title: On a conjecture of King-Tollu-Toumazet for rectangular Kostka coefficients
arxiv:2610.21921.summary: A conjecture of King, Tollu and Toumazet predicts the behavior of small Littlewood--Richardson coefficients under stretching: if $c^{\nu}_{\lambda,\mu}=3$, then $c^{M\nu}_{M\lambda,M\mu}$ equals $2M+1$ or $\binom{M+2}{2}$ for every positive integers $M$. This corresponds to the Hilbert functions of a conic, or of the projective plane. We prove their conjecture for all rectangular Kostka coefficients $K_{\lambda,\mathbf{a}}$.

arxiv:2610.21926.title: An introduction to algebraic groups
arxiv:2610.21926.summary: We review the theory of abelian varieties and, more generally, algebraic groups, with a view toward arithmetic applications. We discuss their models over the rings of integers of number fields, their reductions modulo primes, their torsion points (together with their natural Galois action), and the interplay of these notions through characteristic polynomials of Frobenius.

arxiv:2610.21927.title: On the exact quantization of BCOV Theory on Calabi-Yau Manifolds
arxiv:2610.21927.summary: We announce the solution of constructing perturbative quantum BCOV invariants on arbitrary Calabi-Yau manifolds. In this note, we outline the construction and present an explicit solution. The quantization includes all descendant fields and all loop orders, and expresses the quantum BCOV interaction by an explicit integration over the moduli space of marked Riemann surfaces.

arxiv:2610.21940.title: Cayley graphs of abelian groups, circular colorings and discrete fundamental groups
arxiv:2610.21940.summary: For each integer $k \ge 2$, we prove that an abelian group $\Gamma$ satisfies $\exp(\Gamma) \in \{1,\dots,k\} \cup \{2,4,\dots,2k\}$ if and only if it admits no non-bipartite Cayley graph whose circular chromatic number is strictly less than $2 + \frac{2}{k-1}$. This refines the algebraic characterization by Krebs and Sankar of abelian groups that admit $3$-chromatic Cayley graphs.

arxiv:2610.21945.title: Uniformization of Julia sets of geometrically finite rational maps
arxiv:2610.21945.summary: A Schottky set is the complement of a collection of disjoint open disks in the Riemann sphere. We completely characterize geometrically finite rational maps whose Julia sets are quasiconformally equivalent to Schottky sets. We also prove that the closure of the basin of infinity of a geometrically finite unicritical polynomial is quasiconformally equivalent to a Schottky set if and only if either there exists an attracting cycle and all bounded Fatou components have disjoint closures or there exists a parabolic cycle of multiplicity three.

arxiv:2610.21946.title: A complete classification of perfect state transfer in Grover walks on abelian Cayley graphs
arxiv:2610.21946.summary: We completely classify connected Cayley graphs over finite abelian groups that exhibit perfect state transfer in Grover walks. First, we show that a Cayley graph over any finite group exhibiting perfect state transfer has valency $1$, $2$, or $4$. For valency $4$, we prove that an abelian Cayley graph $\operatorname{Cay}(\Gamma,S)$ exhibits perfect state transfer if and only if $S=\{a,-a,a+h,-a+h\}$, where $h$ has order $2$, and $4\nmid |\Gamma|/2$.

arxiv:2610.21953.title: Postnikov invariants for rational spaces
arxiv:2610.21953.summary: In this paper we construct a theory of Postnikov invariants for (complete) homotopy Lie algebras that is preserved by the integration functor of Robert-Nicoud and Vallette. This result is in the same vein as Berglund's theorem, which relates the homology groups underlying a nilpotent homotopy Lie algebra to the homotopy groups of the associated space. We then deduce an integration functor from filtered Chevalley-Eilenberg homology groups to group cohomology groups.

arxiv:2610.21960.title: The derived category of a generalized complex torus
arxiv:2610.21960.summary: For any translation invariant generalized complex structure J on a torus we construct the derived category D(J) generalizing the derived category of coherent sheaves on a complex torus and the affine/convergent Fukaya category of a symplectic torus. The category is defined in terms of a non-commutative curved deformation of the Dolbeault algebra of a complex torus. We show that this category is independent of the chosen deformation path, which we prove using non-commutative Fourier-Mukai duality.
arxiv:2610.21960.authors: Patrick Antweiler, Vicente Cort\'es, Julian Holstein, Markus R\"oser, Aldo Witte

arxiv:2610.21981.title: Deep Learning of Topological Equivalence Classes
arxiv:2610.21981.summary: We demonstrate an application of deep learning to the problem of identifying whether two generating vectors correspond to topologically equivalent finite group actions on Riemann surfaces, showing how architectures developed for semantic understanding have use for pure mathematical problems. In doing so we discuss how desired algebraic structure influences model design, and explore which structural properties of topological equivalence classes the model has successfully learnt.

arxiv:2610.22001.title: On effective equidistribution for product-type self-affine measures
arxiv:2610.22001.summary: We establish an effective equidistribution theorem on homogeneous spaces for expanding translates of product-type self-affine measures seen on unipotent orbits along any sequence of diagonal elements drifting away from walls. In particular, we do not require the diagonal elements to lie in a fixed proper and closed subcone. The main new ingredients in the proof of our equidistribution theorem include an adaptation of the methods in \cite{BHZ25} to the setting of product-type self-affine measures, as well as a weighted effective recurrence theorem for intertwined associated random walks.

arxiv:2610.22021.title: The asymptotic Erd{\H{o}}s--Frankl--F\"uredi cover-free conjecture
arxiv:2610.22021.summary: In 1985, Erd{\H{o}}s, Frankl and F{\"u}redi conjectured that the threshold $T(r)$ for the existence of an $r$-cover-free family with more members than points satisfies $T(r)=(1+o(1))r^2$. We confirm this conjecture by proving $T(r)\ge r^2+r+2$ for every $r\ge1$.

arxiv:2610.22058.title: Multivariate $P$- and $Q$-polynomial structures of generalized Johnson association schemes
arxiv:2610.22058.summary: Let $\mathfrak X$ be a commutative association scheme of class $d$ on $X$. We construct the generalized Johnson association scheme $\mathfrak J_{n,h}(\mathfrak X)$ on partial maps from $[n]$ to $X$ with domains of size $h$. For $1\le h\le n-1$, we prove that $\mathfrak J_{n,h}(\mathfrak X)$ has $(d+1)$-variate $P$- and $Q$-polynomial structures.

arxiv:2610.22059.title: Perfectoid Pure and Signature Pairs
arxiv:2610.22059.summary: We extend perfectoid purity and related invariants to divisor pairs in mixed characteristic. The resulting purity condition agrees with $F$-purity of pairs in characteristic $p$ as defined by Hara--Watanabe. For normal (respectively, demi-normal) log $\mathbb{Q}$-Gorenstein pairs, we show that perfectoid pure implies log canonical (respectively, semi-log canonical).
arxiv:2610.22059.authors: Hanlin Cai, Anne Fayolle, Linquan Ma, Karl Schwede, Ilya Smirnov, Kevin Tucker, Joe Waldron

arxiv:2610.22072.title: Nonpersistence of full-dimensional tori with polynomial decay in nonlinear Schr\"odinger equations
arxiv:2610.22072.summary: We establish local nonpersistence of full-dimensional invariant tori with polynomially decaying actions for the periodic quintic nonlinear Schr\"odinger equation \[ iu_t-u_{xx}+T_vu+\mu|u|^4u=0,\qquad x\in\mathbb T:=\mathbb R/(2\pi\mathbb Z). \] For every $\kappa\geq1$, we construct a fixed bounded real Fourier multiplier $T_ve^{ijx}=v_je^{ijx}$ whose frequencies $\lambda_j=j^2+v_j$ satisfy the Bourgain-type Diophantine condition \[ \operatorname{dist}\left(\sum_j\ell_j\lambda_j,\mathbb Z\right) \geq\gamma_\kappa\prod_j(1+\ell_j^2\langle j\rangle^{2\kappa})^{-1} \] for some $\gamma_\kappa>0$ and every nonzero finitely supported integer sequence $\ell$, where $\langle…

arxiv:2610.22073.title: Strong invariance principles in deterministic systems
arxiv:2610.22073.summary: We show that in every aperiodic, probability preserving dynamical system there is a function whose associated time series satisfies the almost sure invariance principle with rate asymptotically smaller then $\sqrt{n}$ and the almost sure weak invariance principle of Brosamler and Schatte.

arxiv:2610.22074.title: Normed idempotence of spectra and distributivity in equivariant higher algebra
arxiv:2610.22074.summary: We introduce and develop the theory of distributivity for base categories equipped with so-called atomic orbital subcategories, with an eye towards applications in equivariant homotopy theory. This extends the important framework in Nardin's thesis and supplies several crucial details on distributivity missing from the treatment therein. As our main technical result, we provide a parametrised distributive version of the universal property of "partial cocompletions with relations".
arxiv:2610.22074.authors: Kaif Hilman, Branko Juran, Natalie Stewart

arxiv:2610.22076.title: On the structure of polynomial multicorrelation sequences arising from nilpotent actions
arxiv:2610.22076.summary: We prove that every polynomial multicorrelation sequence arising from nilpotent actions admits a decomposition into a generalized nilsequence and a null-sequence. This resolves a long-standing question of Frantzikinakis concerning the structure of polynomial multicorrelation sequences of commuting transformations. Our proof builds upon ideas underlying the norm convergence theorem of Walsh.

arxiv:2610.22082.title: Integral homology lattices of matching and circulant complexes
arxiv:2610.22082.summary: Bouc's hook cycles span the rational top homology of the matching complex of $K_{2k+1}$. We prove that their integral saturation quotient has exponent exactly $2^{\lfloor k/2\rfloor}$ for every $k\geq1$, and construct divided-power cycles attaining this bound. For $k\geq2$, the homology lattice is not isomorphic to the standard integral hook lattice as an $\mathfrak S_{2k+1}$-module.

arxiv:2610.22098.title: Barrier Log-Concavity of Large Forests
arxiv:2610.22098.summary: We prove that the independence sequence of every sufficiently large forest is strictly barrier log-concave: whenever $i_{k+1}>i_k$, one has $i_k^2>i_{k-1}i_{k+1}$. Consequently, every common downward coefficient tilt is unimodal, with one order threshold valid simultaneously for all $0<t\le1$. As an application, we prove that every sufficiently large well-covered tree has a strictly log-concave independence polynomial.

arxiv:2610.22111.title: The monodromy conjecture for high order poles, and norms of residue antiderivatives
arxiv:2610.22111.summary: We prove the strong local monodromy conjecture for poles of order at least $n-1$ of the naive motivic zeta-function for a complex polynomial of $n$ variables. Moreover, for every such pole $s$, we construct an explicit homology $\exp(2\pi i s)$-eigencycle in a neighborhood of any given 1-dimensional exceptional stratum contributing the pole. The proof combines topological techniques developed by the author with a fact of birational geometry discovered by AI.

arxiv:2610.22123.title: An undecidable problem in dynamics
arxiv:2610.22123.summary: Given a variety $X$ with a self-map $\phi$ and subvarieties $Y$ and $Z$ of $X$, we consider the set of $n$ for which $\phi^n(Y)$ intersects $Z$ nontrivially. Extending a beautiful construction of Lee and Nam, we show this gives rise to an undecidable problem for a fixed ambient variety $X$ and morphism $\phi$. We further use this construction to give a counterexample to a conjecture of the author, Satriano, and Sierra.

arxiv:2610.22135.title: Unavoidable flats in GF(q)-representable matroids
arxiv:2610.22135.summary: We show that, for any finite field $\mathbb{F}$ and positive integer $k$, a simple $\mathbb{F}$-representable matroid $M$ with sufficiently high rank contains a rank-$k$ flat which is either independent in $M$, or is a projective or affine geometry over a subfield of $\mathbb{F}$. This generalizes a result for matroids representable over prime fields due to the first two authors. As a corollary, we obtain a Ramsey theorem for matroids representable over a finite field $\mathbb{F}$.
arxiv:2610.22135.authors: Jim Geelen, Matthew E. Kroeker, Peter Nelson

arxiv:2610.22141.title: Global transfer systems and endopurity of subgroups
arxiv:2610.22141.summary: Global transfer systems are combinatorial objects that parametrize intermediate levels of structures and properties in globally equivariant homotopy theory. In this paper we study the lattice of global transfer systems, expanding beyond the case of abelian groups which was computed by the second author. The main result is a proof that the irreducible elements of the lattice of global transfer systems are strictly controlled by subgroups of groups which we refer to as endopure.

arxiv:2610.22142.title: Wild number for spanning trees in complete and complete bipartite graphs
arxiv:2610.22142.summary: Given an edge-colored graph, the wild number measures how close the graph is to having a spanning tree in every color. We investigate this parameter for complete graphs and complete bipartite graphs, with particular emphasis on minimum proper colorings and equitable $2$-colorings. For complete graphs, we determine the full range of wild numbers attainable by equitable $2$-colorings and show that, although every value in this range occurs, the expected wild number of a uniformly random equitable $2$-coloring tends to $0$ as the order of the graph grows.
arxiv:2610.22142.authors: Aleyah Dawkins, Alexander Nappo, Jessie Tong, Christopher Zimbizi

arxiv:2610.22156.title: Double affine Frobenius Hecke algebras
arxiv:2610.22156.summary: We define double affine Hecke algebras associated to the $\textrm{GL}_n$ and $\textrm{SL}_n$ root data, decorated by a supersymmetric Frobenius superalgebra. When the Frobenius algebra is the group algebra of a finite group, we obtain new double affine versions of the quantum wreath Hecke algebras, and in particular of the affine Yokonuma-Hecke algebras. We prove a basis theorem, describe the centre for generic parameters, and define polynomial representations.

arxiv:2610.22161.title: Gluing weak approximability along recollements
arxiv:2610.22161.summary: We study whether weak approximability glues along recollements of triangulated categories that are compactly generated by a single object. This is applied to derived categories of complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology and prescribed support for quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic spaces.

arxiv:2610.22162.title: The invariant cell number property for $\mathbb{E}_4$-rings
arxiv:2610.22162.summary: For any non-zero $\mathbb{E}_4$-ring $R$, we prove that an $n$-fold direct sum of suspensions of $R$ cannot admit an exhaustive filtration by fewer than $n$ cells. We do this by showing that certain integral representations of the symmetric group lift to Schur functors on additively $\mathbb{E}_3$-monoidal $\infty$-categories. We then reduce the statement to a vanishing fact for rational Schur functors due to Deligne.

arxiv:2610.22180.title: A quadratic ancestor inequality for spanning trees
arxiv:2610.22180.summary: We introduce a quadratic ancestor inequality for weighted spanning trees on finite undirected graphs and give two applications. First, for every finite $n$-vertex transitive graph, the expected distance in its uniform spanning tree (UST) between two independent uniform vertices is at least $\sqrt{n}-1$, resolving a conjecture in [Benjamini--Kozma, Comm. Math.

arxiv:2610.22189.title: The role of friction on heave-induced motion of offshore drilling systems: modelling, analysis, and numerical experiments
arxiv:2610.22189.summary: This paper investigates the influence of friction dynamics on heave-induced disturbance propagation using a coupled hydraulic-structural drilling model formulated as a semilinear interconnection of ordinary and hyperbolic partial differential equations (ODE-PDEs), and capturing spatially distributed memory effects in the drillstring-wellbore interaction. First, local and global existence and uniqueness results are established, and sufficient conditions for boundedness and input-to-state stability are deduced via a small-gain analysis. Subsequently, extensive numerical investigations are carried out, including harmonic excitation studies, nonlinear distortion analysis, spatial amplification…

arxiv:2610.22190.title: Connectivity Bounds for GHZ Graphs
arxiv:2610.22190.summary: Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) states are multipartite entangled quantum states that play a central role in quantum information theory, with applications in quantum communication, cryptography, and distributed quantum computing. A major experimental goal is to create high-dimensional GHZ states using multiple entangled parties. Krenn, Gu and Zeilinger discovered a surprising bridge between these quantum-optical experiments and graph theory: certain photonic experiments can be represented by edge-coloured, edge-weighted graphs, and the dimension of the produced GHZ state equals the number of feasible monochromatic inherited vertex colourings.

arxiv:2610.22203.title: Series of Fano quiver moduli from extended Dynkin quivers
arxiv:2610.22203.summary: Associated to small extended Dynkin quivers, we construct series of Fano varieties of fixed Picard rank at most five and arbitrary even dimension, which admit a very explicit description of their geometry. For example, they all admit a flat morphism to a projective space, whose general fiber is a product of projective lines. We also give a closed formula for all Betti numbers, and interpret this formula in terms of an action of a cohomological Hall algebra on the cohomology of all the varieties in a series.

arxiv:2610.22218.title: Logical isomorphism and logical limit laws for small permutation classes and regular languages
arxiv:2610.22218.summary: In this paper we show that for each small permutation class $\mathcal{F}$ there exists a regular language $L_\mathcal{F}$ such that the monadic second-order TOTO logic on $\mathcal{F}$ is isomorphic to classical monadic second-order logic on $L_\mathcal{F}$. Thanks to the fact that regular languages are closed under monadic second-order restrictions this shows that many subsets of $\mathcal{F}$ have a well-behaved structure. In particular, this allows us to show that random permutations from any small permutation class satisfies convergence laws for both first-order logic and monadic second-order logic.

arxiv:2610.22226.title: Variation of Shafarevich-Tate groups in Hida families
arxiv:2610.22226.summary: Let $\mathbf{f}$ be a Hida family of cusp forms over a standard (power series) Iwasawa algebra. We determine the pseudo-isomorphism class of the big Shafarevich-Tate group attached to $\mathbf{f}$ over a suitable imaginary quadratic field by describing all its higher Fitting ideals; this description is given in terms of the universal Kolyvagin system of Howard's big Heegner points. As a second contribution, we study the variation of the structure of the Shafarevich-Tate groups of the classical specializations of $\mathbf{f}$.
arxiv:2610.22226.authors: Enrico Da Ronche, Matteo Longo, Stefano Vigni, Francesco Zerman

arxiv:2610.22235.title: Classes of integrable metrics on Banach spaces
arxiv:2610.22235.summary: We introduce a large new class of (weak) metrics on the Hardy space that have infinite families of conservation laws in involution. The construction of the metrics and the integrals involve the Hankel operator and a field of Nijehuis operators. The commutativity of the integrals is based on the notion of the coupling transform, which allows us to recursively construct new classes of metrics and integrals.

arxiv:2610.22241.title: Geometric Graph Representations via Compact SAT Encodings
arxiv:2610.22241.summary: We present compact SAT encodings and certifying exact solvers for boxicity and cubicity. The boxicity of a graph is the minimum dimension in which it is the intersection graph of axis-aligned boxes; cubicity is defined analogously using unit cubes. Grid-based formulations face a geometric discretization bottleneck, growing rapidly with the target dimension.
arxiv:2610.22241.authors: L. Sunil Chandran, Rishikesh Gajjala, Suraj Kumar Sahoo, Aatman Supkar

arxiv:2610.22251.title: Deterministic Determination of Axial Constants, Sectional Regularities and Annihilator Numbers
arxiv:2610.22251.summary: Axial constants and sectional regularities are recently introduced invariants of homogeneous polynomial ideals that, like the already earlier introduced annihilator numbers, depend on generic choices of coordinates. We provide effective characterisations of the genericity underlying these invariants in terms of $\beta$-maximal position and strong stability. In particular, we show that $\beta$-maximal position suffices for determining generic annihilator numbers and sectional regularities, while its combination with strong stability yields corresponding results for axial constants.
arxiv:2610.22251.authors: Amir Hashemi, Rozhin Sadr, Werner M. Seiler

arxiv:2610.22268.title: Uniform Intersection Numbers and Subgroup-Based Generating Graphs of Groups
arxiv:2610.22268.summary: The uniform intersection number of a finite group $G$, denoted by $ui(G)$, is the smallest positive integer $k$ such that the intersection of any $k$ distinct maximal subgroups of $G$ is equal to its Frattini subgroup. We determine the uniform intersection number of dicyclic, dihedral, and quasi-dihedral groups. We then investigate the uniform intersection number through the subgroup-based generating graph $\mathcal{G}(G)$ of a finite group $G$.

arxiv:2610.22279.title: Tensor-generating line bundles on toric varieties
arxiv:2610.22279.summary: A line bundle is $\otimes$-generating if its powers generate the derived category of perfect complexes. Refining the derived Nakai--Moishezon criterion of Ito--Olander, we characterize $\otimes$-generating line bundles on proper toric varieties by a combinatorial criterion on the fan, leading to the notion of $\otimes$-generating fans characterizing $\otimes$-generating canonical bundles. Furthermore, we prove an analogue of Kleiman's criterion of ampleness for $\otimes$-generation.
arxiv:2610.22279.authors: Daigo Ito, Michael R. Zeng, Xiangru Zeng

arxiv:2610.22281.title: Counterexamples to the ordinary Fried conjecture near hyperbolic metrics
arxiv:2610.22281.summary: We give an LLM-assisted construction of counterexamples to the ordinary Fried conjecture, with real analytic metrics arbitrarily close to a hyperbolic metric in dimension three. For acyclic unitary line characters tending to the trivial character, the modulus of the Ruelle zeta function at zero divided by analytic torsion squared tends to zero.

arxiv:2610.22286.title: Causal Fingerprints Reveal Hidden Mechanisms in Partially-Observed Dynamical Systems
arxiv:2610.22286.summary: In partially-observed dynamical systems, distinct hidden mechanisms can produce similar observable summary statistics while explaining individual events differently. We introduce causal fingerprints: realization-dependent patterns that track how information about a hidden state is revealed through subsequent evolution. Within a prescribed dynamical model, we compare the filtering posterior, based on observations up to a given time, with the smoothing posterior, obtained after adding an expanding window of future observations.
arxiv:2610.22286.authors: Zhang Jiang, Marios Andreou, Nan Chen

arxiv:2610.22288.title: Extending Donaldson's HyperK\"ahler Structure via Minimal Surfaces into $\mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb{C})$
arxiv:2610.22288.summary: We construct a deformation space for minimal immersions into $\mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb{C})$ with its holomorphic Killing form, and define an explicit, mapping class group invariant, complex hyperK\"ahler structure on such deformation space. Such complex hyperK\"ahler structure restricts to: Donaldson's hyperK\"ahler structure on a totally real copy of almost-Fuchsian space, Mazzoli-Seppi-Tamburelli's para-hyperK\"ahler structure on a totally real copy of maximally globally hyperbolic $\mathbb{A}\mathrm{d}\mathbb{S}^3$ manifolds, and Loustau-Sanders' complex bi-K\"ahler structure on a holomorphic copy of quasi-Fuchsian space. Moreover, all these loci are totally geodesic.
arxiv:2610.22288.authors: Christian El Emam, Filippo Mazzoli, Nicholas Rungi, Andrea Seppi, Andrea Tamburelli

arxiv:2610.22299.title: An Induced Subgraph Paradigm for Strongly Regular Graph Constructions
arxiv:2610.22299.summary: How many disjoint copies of some graph $H$ can appear in an induced subgraph of a strongly regular graph? We give upper and lower bounds that depend on the number of vertices in their boundary. This generalizes a result of Lou-Murin which bounds the independence number of a (hitherto still elusive) strongly regular graph with parameters $(99,14,1,2)$.

arxiv:2610.22305.title: $h$-cobordisms between $1$-connected manifolds with boundary
arxiv:2610.22305.summary: We classify $h$-cobordisms between compact simply-connected $4$-manifolds with boundary in both the smooth and topological categories. This extends a result of Kreck, which proved the corresponding result for closed manifolds. As an application, we recover the injectivity portion of Orson-Powell's computation of the mapping class group for simply-connected topological $4$-manifolds with boundary.

arxiv:2610.22326.title: Stratification of opers with apparent singularities and isomonodromic bubbling
arxiv:2610.22326.summary: On a compact Riemann surface of genus $g \geq 2$, we study Simpson's stratification of the de Rham moduli space of rank-2 flat connections. Upon representing flat $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{C})$-connections by branched projective structures, or equivalently by opers with apparent singularities, the stratum containing a flat connection is determined by the minimal number of apparent singularities needed to represent it. We construct explicit holomorphic families in which two simple apparent singularities collide and disappear, so that the family crosses into a smaller stratum; this realizes Simpson's closure relation between strata near generic points.
arxiv:2610.22326.authors: Duong Dinh, Troy Figiel, Joerg Teschner

arxiv:2610.22359.title: Integral and higher-genus quantum McKay correspondence in type D
arxiv:2610.22359.summary: We establish Iritani's integral form of the $\mathbb{C}^\times$-equivariant Crepant Transformation Conjecture (CTC) for the minimal resolution of the surface singularity $\mathbb{C}^2/\mathbb{BD}_{4n}$, where $\mathbb{BD}_{4n}$ is the binary dihedral group of order $4n$. We then use Givental's quantisation formalism to prove the all-genus full-descendent CTC in that case. As an application, we deduce the Bryan-Cadman-Young degree-zero form of the orbifold Gromov-Witten/Donaldson-Thomas correspondence for the Calabi-Yau 3-orbifold $[\mathbb{C}^2/\mathbb{BD}_{4n}] \times \mathbb{C}$.
